| Fellow American, I wanted you to hear about this from me. _**I just filed a request with the New York Committee on Professional Standards urging the state 's Attorney Grievance Committee to investigate and disbar AG Letitia James for her unprofessional and malicious handling of her case against President Trump.**_ As open borders policies and disastrous "no bail" laws have led to a crime wave in the Empire State it appears that NY's Attorney General is only interested in launching personal attacks against her political opponents and prosecuting a non-criminal dispute over the value of some of President Trump's real estate assets. At that time Ms. James was leading "die-in" protests against President Trump and claimed that she was leading "the resistance" against him in NYC where she will "continue to do so in every way possible." It cannot be understated how damaging these partisan witch-hunts are for the country and they must be put to an end immediately. We got some sobering news in Michigan: Nonpartisan political forecasters at Inside Elections just downgraded the Michigan Senate race from a “Lean Democrat” state for the 2024 elections to only “Tilt Democrat.”
We’re going to explain why this is specifically important to the Senate race, but first, we have to ask: [**Will you chip in $3 or any amount now to help us keep Michigan blue and defend the Senate majority in November?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-feb24.z4X5uQ&refcode=em240214-2-30&t=2&akid=1135%2E135344%2EbwLD88)

Why is this downgrade important?
First, it confirms something Michiganders already knew, which is that Michigan is NOT a solidly blue state. The moment people sleep on Michigan and our previous successes, Democrats lose the state. We need to be doing everything we can right now to set us up for success on Election Day so we can protect the White House and defend the Senate.
Secondly, National Republicans also view Michigan as a key battleground state for both the presidential race and the Senate, which is why we’ve already seen two visits from Trump this election cycle, not including his rally in Michigan this upcoming weekend.

We’ve already seen over $1 million from a super PAC propping up one of our opponents, and we know that more is on the way.

Patriot,

This is a deeply personal email, but I want to tell you why it's critical for us to take back our culture and education from the radical left... not just in sports, but even in children's books.

My story begins at the University of Kentucky. I was on the swim team. I am a 12-time NCAA all-American, 5x SEC champion, and SEC record holder in the butterfly.

But then it all changed for a photo-opt.

In March of 2022, I and other female swimmers were forced to compete with a male, Lia Thomas. We watched as this male swam to a title, beating out Olympians and other record holders. Despite tying Lia to the 100th of a second, the NCAA denied me the trophy because the NCAA claimed it was necessary to have Lia Thomas hold the trophy while photos were being taken.

The radical left reduced everything I worked my entire life for down to a photo opt.

But that's not all...

I was forced to share locker rooms with a 6'4" man.

**_This is where the madness needs to end because it 's not just sports where the radical gender ideology movement is dominating_.**

I don’t mince words because the reality for too many Americans is harsh and dark. **Our wages are shit while the powerful sit in their mansions, their boats, and their fancy cars and ignore us.** If you are ready to join the class struggle and help me be the voice of the voiceless in the Senate, I need your help. [**Will you chip in $10, $25, or our average donation of $33.99 today?**](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQaVm62-bQ2x2VAus3ojv4C-nMgSyk0iLQcvbTce3UgoW&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=021424_video&n=4)**** And when I say the voiceless, I don’t mean just every West Virginian, American, and all who call this country a home. I also mean Palestinian civilians whom our corporate media, political elites, and our members of Congress have tried to dehumanize completely. Just yesterday, the U.S. Senate shamelessly approved $14 billion in military aid to Israel to continue the ongoing genocide...using our taxes. American politics affects the lives of people far beyond our borders. The same moneyed interests that don’t want our wages to increase, that deny us universal health care, that destroy our environment, and that incarcerate us are behind our derailed foreign policy that destabilizes other countries and entire regions and brings primarily black and brown communities famine, disease, and despair. [**I****f you want a Senator whose positions are deeply rooted in human rights—domestically and abroad****—join our campaign today.**](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQaVm62-bQ2x2VAus3ojv4C-nMgSyk0iLQcvbTce3UgoW&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=021424_video&n=5) Thank you, Zach Shrewsbury (D-WV) Candidate, U.S. Senate

body:
Jimmy Gomez has accepted over $100,000 in donations from Pro-Israel groups, while he refuses to sign a resolution calling for a ceasefire in Gaza. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/davidkimforca/stand-for-peace-join-david-in-making-a-difference?e=fee98d637f)
---
| |
---
| | Hello friend,

In these times of hardship and strife, the values of human rights and peace are more important than ever. We must scrutinize any public figure who votes and gets donations from conflicting interests that go against these values.
The elephant in the room?

Jimmy Gomez’s campaign affiliations. While he has REFUSED to sign on to the House Resolution calling for a ceasefire in Gaza, he has accepted over $100,000 in donations from Pro-Israel groups, with more than [$90,000 coming from AIPAC alone](https://davidkimforca.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c05fe848bb5af5e7b9d690b2f&id=8bcfec3b86&e=fee98d637f).

While he releases statements on social media calling for a temporary “cessation of hostilities”, he has taken ZERO legislative action to secure peace and bring an end to a conflict that has cost the lives of thousands, and displaced millions. In fact, he is on the record calling for more funding to be sent to Israel to support their efforts.

This isn’t just politics as usual. In times like these we need leaders that put our community, our nation, and our humanity first. We strive to have elected officials that truly represent progressive principles. Your involvement becomes indispensable.

David Kim believes in the power of peace and human rights. David’s campaign is more than just one person; it’s a grassroots movement, rooted in the values we hold dear.

David is organizing a canvassing event this weekend and needs your help. This is your chance to make a tangible difference by ensuring a true progressive who believes in human rights. Your voice, your time, and your commitment will improve our world. Sign up [HERE](https://davidkimforca.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c05fe848bb5af5e7b9d690b2f&id=a9a94c29b1&e=fee98d637f)!

Time sensitive update? ? ? ? ? Peter,

The midterm elections are almost here and candidates across the country need your support to help them finish strong!

It is not an exaggeration to say that this November's elections could have consequential impacts that span generations if we lose, especially in key state races across the country. That is why we are excited to partner with Julia Louis-Dreyfus, NRDC Action Votes, and GiveGreen over the next three days to help raise critical funds for several key races in places like Arizona, Michigan, Nevada, and Wisconsin!

For the next 72 hours, a group of generous donors have agreed to match the first $10,000 in support of key Attorneys General and Secretaries of State races. Winning these races is crucial to protecting our election integrity, and they are counting on the support of climate and democracy donors like YOU!

Are you all in to win big in Arizona, Michigan, Nevada and Wisconsin? Then donate directly to this slate of democracy defenders today and your gift will be matched by a group of several generous donors! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/rNykfk_~RjFv/QTBqMkhwTFA1MU1TT3RNMndRb0k0Tlg3SUdVQmd3aEw3RVFYQWtMR0F0c3N3eEdPcG8zWjFYV2ZIRm90MGhZQmFUUEs2c1VKNXBoNHVYeVFQd05nQzNWbnAreWFzWHJNeXBnUGV2UUZmdUE9S0/

We need you all in to reelect Attorneys General Dana Nessel (Michigan), Aaron Ford (Nevada), Josh Kaul (Wisconsin) and Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson (Michigan). They are critical leaders in their states and will do everything they can to protect the ballot box and our right to vote.

We also have incredible opportunities to flip a few Secretary of State and Attorney General seats across the country this November. Cisco Aguilar in Nevada is running for Secretary of State and Kris Mayes in Arizona is running for Attorney General.

Losing any of these Secretary of State OR Attorney General races would be devastating for our planet, communities, and democracy. Dear Peter,
The crisis at the border has reached unimaginable proportions, with devastating consequences for our nation.
The body bags keep piling up. Drugs and human trafficking run rampant. Our cities and towns are overrun and strained to the max. The number of illegal migrants in the United States has roughly _DOUBLED_ under President Biden.
Last night, Biden's own Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas was impeached by the House of Representatives for his failure to enforce border laws. This unprecedented move underscores the urgency and severity of the situation we face.
Our country is on the brink of being lost, and we cannot afford to remain silent any longer.
[That’s why I’m asking you to sign this petition demanding President Biden secure the border now. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/border-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_2_14_24_email_1_2_non&n=6)
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://www.kennedy24.com/border-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_2_14_24_email_1_2_non&n=7)
Under his watch, the number of people taken into custody by the U.S. Border Patrol has reached an average of 2 million per year — the highest levels in the agency’s 100-year history.
President Biden continues to play chicken with our lives and refuses to use executive authority to secure the border. _In fact, he walked back many of the restrictions that were keeping the crisis under control._
_This is a deliberate political move._
President Biden has held office for 50 years — he’s playing dumb when he pretends he doesn’t know what to do. He’s playing politics when he ties border security to overseas war funding.
It’s egregious that in the United States __we have illegal migrants sleeping in hotels while veterans sleep on the street__.
Enough is enough.
[Sign this petition demanding President Biden secure the border.](https://www.kennedy24.com/border-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_2_14_24_email_1_2_non&n=8)

I've spent my life serving this state
| | |
---
Friend, this message is a bit on the longer side, but I hope you'll take the time to read it. **[This Valentine's Day, I want to tell you about how I truly feel about the Sunshine State. You see, in a lot of ways, this campaign is a love letter to Florida.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79037624/455268698/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk809-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWVmZDFhNjgtYTljYi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Lhf6PYqLAUP8uAtzlWClQrvqhX5EIpts2BPfbxJnLVE=)**
I can still remember the first time that I came to Florida. I was working on my Masters degree and had just gotten the news that my beloved father had been killed by a criminal with a gun in Ecuador, where I was born. As I grappled with my grief, I found myself missing Ecuador more than I had in years. I missed its warmth, lush greenery, and close-knit communities that I grew up with. My older sister, Monica, knew our family was struggling, so she convinced me to visit her in Miami, where she had recently moved.
When I stepped outside of the airport, it was like stepping into another world. **It was warm, wonderfully humid, bustling with lively, diverse communities, lush, and all so, so beautifully green.** We spent the next few days visiting all of Monica's favorite places in her new city — the spots with the most beautiful views and the best cafes to get a _cafecito_. The people we met were even warmer than the weather. Everyone was welcoming, friendly, and proud to call this state their home.
I boarded my plane back to my home with a heavy heart but a new resolve. **As soon as I was able, I sold my car and moved across the country to make a new home in Miami.**(My mom, always my closest confidant, wasn't far behind.)
Since moving here all those years ago, I've had the privilege to build a beautiful life in the Sunshine State. **I fell in love here, found the community I had longed for, raised a family of my own, and dedicated my career to serving this state.** I've helped protect the Everglades, expanded access to health care, worked for Florida International University, and became the first South American immigrant elected to Congress, right here in Florida.
I've spent my life serving this state and getting to know the communities who call it home. But my opponent, Rick Scott, has spent his career scamming Floridians, lying to voters, and making himself richer. **He wants you to think that Florida families agree with his extreme, hateful agenda._But I can promise you, friend, that couldn't be further from the truth._**
Listen, my campaign is deeply personal because of my love for this state — and more importantly, because of what it will mean for my fellow Floridians. Rick Scott wants to sow division and undo decades of meaningful progress. He wants to destroy reproductive rights, gun safety laws, and vital public services, like Medicare and Social Security, that support millions of his constituents, including my own mother.

Florida is ready for a change — I hear it from voters every day as I travel around all 67 counties. I know this November, Floridians will choose unity, progress, and kindness over Rick Scott's extremist agenda.

But the truth is, we're up against a mega-millionaire who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time. If we're going to break through Rick Scott's lies, build unstoppable grassroots momentum, and win this critical race, I'll need your help.

**[Please, will you donate $5 (or whatever you can spare today) to help me defeat Rick Scott and give our home the leadership that we deserve? This _will_ be the year that we flip Florida blue, but only if grassroots activists like _you_ believe in my campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79037625/455268699/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk809-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWVmZDFhNjgtYTljYi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Lhf6PYqLAUP8uAtzlWClQrvqhX5EIpts2BPfbxJnLVE=)**

This week, nearly 124 million people tuned in to watch the Super Bowl, and a dramatic comeback by Kansas City to overcome San Francisco not for the first time. Meanwhile, Washington's global military industrial complex suffered not only continued military setbacks from Ukraine to Gaza, but also a remarkable _electoral_ defeat at the hands of the people of Pakistan.
Guess which set of events prompted more observations from U.S. media sources?
If people in a poor, marginalized country can see through the machinations of their own military and media to boldly seek their own liberation, why can't Americans do the same?
Embedded in the answer is a revelation of crises spanning, journalism, politics, democracy, and media. It implicates not only the military industrial corruption that Washington exports around the planet, but also the complicity of journalists and editors who mistake the values of their own profession, prioritizing the promotion of entertainment before the public accountability to which their profession is ethically committed.
[shiftingyourparadigm](https://substack.com/redirect/1f8af37a-22b3-42e9-b391-00ccde71643a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/44ad6bc7-b7b5-4054-8444-9c45ebec1e20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A post shared by [@shiftingyourparadigm](https://substack.com/redirect/1f8af37a-22b3-42e9-b391-00ccde71643a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### **What we watch**
Super Bowl LVIII saw the Kansas City Chiefs triumph over the San Francisco 49ers in a dramatic game decided in overtime. With nearly 124 million live viewers, it was nearly the most widely watched broadcast in history. The [only](https://substack.com/redirect/9e1d82ef-1893-4308-8501-e10a2f7d2852?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) event ever watched by a larger live audience was the moon landing in 1969.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c3063651-2b37-4b77-b348-2685e42f2dad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Before diving in, it's worth observing the course of the game itself, and a pattern that has seemed to emerge between the two teams that played it.
This is not the first time that the 49ers have lost to the Chiefs in the Super Bowl. [Four years ago](https://substack.com/redirect/05ab889c-e46c-4f66-acfe-281f2e785996?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the Chiefs came from behind in the fourth quarter to score 21 unanswered points, beating the 49ers 31-20.
[I]t's tough not to observe the expression of karma evident in the team choking repeatedly on national television after cutting quarterback Colin Kaepernick in 2020 for the crime of silently and respectfully dissenting from continuing patterns of murderous state violence.
This past weekend, the Chiefs [again](https://substack.com/redirect/d2aaf61e-d4f6-4b19-8f63-21bb38b4e870?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) came from behind to beat San Francisco, which led 10-3 at halftime and 19-16 with under two minutes remaining in the game. Kansas City's field goal in the final seconds of the game forced overtime, before a three-yard touchdown pass with just three seconds left in overtime sealed the Chiefs' third NFL championship in five years.
San Francisco not only squandered leads in both Super Bowls, but also committed a series of "[self-inflicted wounds](https://substack.com/redirect/63f9a209-e44f-467e-aefb-d53a7b188cff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" that make this past weekend's an [especially stinging defeat](https://substack.com/redirect/5abbd36f-3cf7-4545-b71c-b967745be020?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for 49ers fans.
_Thank you for reading! This post is public. Feel free to share it._
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=141686155&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQxNjg2MTU1LCJpYXQiOjE3MDc5NzY1ODgsImV4cCI6MTcxMDU2ODU4OCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.R2s8vhB5Q-2OfqORhoc29D5cqZBjY6Gyye9ID40xpY0)
### **What most forgot**
Having left San Francisco to recover my life from a public character assassination orchestrated in 2020 to neutralize the threat I once posed to the city's political establishment, I must confess to feeling no shortage of [schadenfreude](https://substack.com/redirect/ef808647-ea09-4b4f-b19b-01c6d9cfc0aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) following the 49ers' loss.
From my vantage point, it's tough not to observe the expression of karma evident in the team choking repeatedly on national television after cutting quarterback Colin Kaepernick in 2020 for the crime of [silently and respectfully](https://substack.com/redirect/28abf01e-747a-4bff-809e-6c992e84b252?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) dissenting from [continuing](https://substack.com/redirect/7123fb3c-7af0-4b47-a9e0-2de7823c92e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) patterns of murderous state violence. To his inestimable credit, Kaepernick has gone on despite being blacklisted by the NFL to establish a prolific [career](https://substack.com/redirect/8e5ee4b5-6e92-4cd1-84e1-0df586043270?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as a philanthropist and public figure whose voice and interests reach far beyond sports.
Setting Kap himself aside for a moment, there's some irony to San Francisco suffering repeated defeats in the Super Bowl. First, the city is home to the [most dense concentration](https://substack.com/redirect/1ca052b7-c4a4-46bc-9d50-ad40310085c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of millionaires and [billionaires](https://substack.com/redirect/449b01b2-c224-4000-ab69-8a52184584fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the planet. While New York and Hong Kong are both home to more billionaires, each of those cities' populations dwarf San Francisco's by an order of magnitude. One might take some satisfaction in a smug city run by tech capital failing to translate its preposterous wealth into victory on the football field.
More sharply, however, the juxtaposition between Kaepernick's blacklisting and San Francisco's Super Bowl loss is even more laden with irony than most observers realize. When Kap took a knee to protest police violence, he did so in a city that has managed to [drive out](https://substack.com/redirect/9832d8ff-86f4-410a-b6ed-89c3650da470?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) approximately 75% of its once [substantial Black population](https://substack.com/redirect/29319469-4b1e-4613-9cb6-0ff53166cad6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over the past generation. Despite its progressive reputation, San Francisco has so long been besieged by racism that James Baldwin produced [a documentary film](https://substack.com/redirect/5b6cf37c-495b-43f9-94dc-8c9152ff9f46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about specifically that in 1964. My own experience running for Congress [forced me to confront it](https://substack.com/redirect/d55645db-c755-4886-9aed-8561407e81c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more squarely then I would have ever hoped.
No city as [racist](https://substack.com/redirect/958202d0-3859-490c-a6e0-20052ff2d928?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or [ignorant](https://substack.com/redirect/98cc3a84-a154-4bcd-85da-0fc5a66368fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as San Francisco deserves to win national championships.
### **What they show**
Beyond the drama offered by the Super Bowl, its public coverage offers a straightforward reflection of how journalism has failed the public, as well as its own values.
Journalism is [ethically committed](https://substack.com/redirect/892e2fec-829f-477a-af18-5519d2584903?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to informing the public about issues of public concern, and ensuring transparency and public accountability. That's the reason why the First Amendment protects, among other things, freedom of the press.
Every one of the thousands of articles and broadcasts published before, during, and since the Super Bowl ignored those goals entirely. What accountability is promoted by analyses of football?
Instead, each of those stories represented [corporate propaganda](https://substack.com/redirect/996f48fd-93aa-4300-9057-d9fd40116be9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) promoting a sports league [insulated](https://substack.com/redirect/f5ea413b-47ac-4154-9033-b6f6554cc62c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by a corrupt Congress from long established antitrust laws that restrain most other industries. In other words, journalists--by the thousands--abandoned their mission to support public accountability to instead reinforce the unaccountability of corporate corruption that in turn continues to rely on bipartisan political corruption in Washington.
The work of sports writers is the equivalent of product reviews comparing brands of shampoo.
Even if sports leagues had not been insulated from antitrust laws by corrupt members of Congress, sports "journalism" would remain, at best, [a distraction from real journalism](https://substack.com/redirect/01e437b2-8b1d-40f0-bc44-d266c7d44b3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) reporting on issues that actually influence the future. But to describe sports "journalism" as a mere distraction mistakes how much coverage of sports, fashion, and entertainment dominates the American media landscape. It vastly outshines and obscures real reporting on matters of urgent interest to the entire globe.

### **What they missed in the past**
For the last 75 years, the United States has been waging [a relentless war on countries across the global South](https://substack.com/redirect/13755b2c-8d6f-4e66-ba9c-0682bb0d9383?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to force their natural resources onto international markets, engineer a preventable climate catastrophe, and degrade human rights, as well as the human rights institutions that America fought a World War to establish in the last century.
That pattern continues today--not only from Vietnam to Iraq, and more recently from Ukraine to Gaza, but also in other theaters that the American press more or less ignores entirely.
For example, Washington [executed](https://substack.com/redirect/29e80bd1-3abf-47e7-9d60-408ed4971078?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a prolific act of [international terrorism](https://substack.com/redirect/e3a83cb1-3e90-4cc7-b2e0-b3aee41f0a50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) two years ago, bombing a gas pipeline that led to the largest release of methane in recorded history. Yet American newspapers [continue](https://substack.com/redirect/248a4705-e81d-4f7f-9d0d-c0b0640eb057?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to suppress the story, despite it having been documented by the [very same journalist](https://substack.com/redirect/d6b9aadf-4298-4a94-884d-78bcbbca6164?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who uncovered a massacre of hundreds of Vietnamese civilians by U.S. Marines in 1968.
The American press suppressing news about Washington bombing the Nordstream pipeline is just part of a longer pattern. It stretches from [false](https://substack.com/redirect/59001af5-5af9-4078-bb21-4ee9dab6f93a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) claims about weapons of mass destruction in Iraq to [suppressing](https://substack.com/redirect/b10ec428-f5a7-4fe1-a3fc-f9333b58d854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) real stories about unconstitutional domestic surveillance, internationally illegal [torture](https://substack.com/redirect/6c6ee8f9-2e2d-46c8-9c90-18488550ff1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the devious (and eventually admitted) CIA scheme to flood US cities with crack cocaine in the 90s that not only funded the Agency's rogue and illegal foreign policy and human rights violations, but ultimately created a pretext to legally enslave a generation of prisoners.
Last year, The Intercept (an investigative publication that usually does a good job, although I have the distinction of serving as a walking poster child of its editors' [disappointing failures](https://substack.com/redirect/5be40276-6c0e-4a51-ae4d-ec31cd71225a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) published an expose about [a U.S. State department cable](https://substack.com/redirect/77355817-78f2-47bf-9626-70f35f8eab9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) calling for the intelligence services in Pakistan to remove democratically elected Prime Minister Imran Khan.
Of course, Washington and its clients in Islamabad [denied](https://substack.com/redirect/5dc89ef1-2bc8-4e5a-9b27-e0ff4f6fdc4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the very existence of the cable before it was eventually published, exposing lies by officials from one side of the world to the other. Preposterously, the elected head of state was then charged with violating its national security by leaking the cable, which essentially confirmed that a foreign power was staging a bloodless coup.
It is farcical to claim that a country's national security is at stake when a democratically elected leader simply tries to alert the public to a hostile takeover attempt by a foreign power. Yet that is the claim of the intelligence services across Pakistan, and all of the major media sources that serve them--until the recent election forced them to change their tune.
### **What they missed last week**
Whereas the United States appears to be a country of compliant sheep willing to defer to bipartisan corruption, Pakistanis--despite wielding far fewer resources, enjoying far less access to information, and having been subject for decades to the political whims of its unaccountable military--shrugged off the influence of Washington and the Pentagon to [challenge](https://substack.com/redirect/77d8c9cd-0864-4199-8b2f-daf194b90e3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) their country's military establishment in national elections last week. Even more remarkably, they did so even as the military took various steps to undermine democracy and secure its own power.
Despite violence targeting opposition candidates, bogus charges facing former Prime Minister Imran Khan, restraints on the press, and formal interventions designed to skew the electoral outcome in the military's favor (including banning the main opposition party's candidates from appearing on ballots or using their party's name or iconography), the opposition somehow appeared to be [winning a majority of seats](https://substack.com/redirect/547a8b40-3a92-478d-a7d9-127cbbb5cee0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) before the military stepped in more aggressively to dictate the outcome.
For largely uneducated Pakistani voters to so thoroughly reject the military establishment that has so dominated the country's brief history is remarkable. It should particularly shame Americans who defer to Republicans and Democrats despite the [corruption](https://substack.com/redirect/83c59bb4-1be2-4348-8ce2-399bb459cac5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) they visibly share, and the [belligerent foreign policy](https://substack.com/redirect/97719b4b-e71f-4885-9fc0-9b058f850a38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) they [together](https://substack.com/redirect/437f9bf5-4dd8-4ad5-a0c8-1c78cdd17f1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) craft to force on countries including Pakistan.
Ironically, the inability of Americans to see through the propaganda promoted by both corporate parties is what enables the foreign policy that, in turn, has undermined democracy in countries from Pakistan to the [Philippines](https://substack.com/redirect/82b3a79b-fdf0-488f-8c6b-54be0c46366c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and, until recently, [Brazil](https://substack.com/redirect/b3e010c1-7da8-4ea8-94f5-b4b70a5e9acd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
If people in a poor, marginalized country can see through the machinations of their own military and media to boldly seek their own liberation, why can't Americans do the same?
The answer is sadly simple: we're too busy watching football games. America's international belligerence relies on its domestic ignorance. And the people getting paid to report on the news are doing a great job of maintaining it.

If contrived corporate holidays grate on your nerves, you might like some of these songs! They span a few decades, and while you've likely heard some on the radio, others are less famous--including one I wrote for a longtime friend, teacher, collaborator, and lover many years ago who thankfully (and ironically, given the song's title and lyrics) remains in my life to this day..._

name: American Briefing
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history,

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zv8fdg7cjj6ark2umatt67gp3u0fpm31d4ugdug8_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjie2p76c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zic59dlcef9f11236okl0l5hkc8r34inqde8or18_rp22sh2s8i6eo37cjie2p76c1h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.

# How We Win in 2024
---
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
In the 2022 election, Dina Titus squeaked by with just 51.6% of the vote - the lowest percentage of all other Democrats who won Congressional elections in Nevada.
We proved we can beat Titus. We beat Titus in Henderson. We beat Titus in Boulder City. We beat Titus by 20 points with in-person voters. Her very narrow victory was only because of Democrat ballot harvesting and mail-in voting. A [recent study by Heartland/Rasmussen](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001VFQSZ_9_m48hRG5kCozz_UA9yHlnYPRXqKDznEswVZVIe5TxApPLrVeD3IQgDO_3zOeGAQ6PStyQxFjV9Mecf5kBUre5pb4FOZjdgAG7EEOCrTlSPRf3-YFV8OlYHmMW5Ph4susU5UsogO9KdDmAGFLnnc69PLjb2-4GZPgCnsT60dLze1c7Skuvp18om5ZtQqoYO_CEex22giFXM0m5_JvgeLBv8GwLmHJTWQR5E2L4_vgAiPCewNTv9xa_KTvJTglTgVRAj_kKIo-7DPqxrbnyVUbcI8AeAjgqjEQWyTdcBeFsZoYe4ovz7Gf7Tb9RZYEJ9_ihhpo=&c=k6YNY3zs_5lV6FUDexSbVqWFVQw5i7Sj9guesYTJg7Sikn6_nR_hKw==&ch=-WmQ9nqHUt6s1eL9eZscU-eWEeG8Nx4Z3F_f6qLjU8E-BGuW49rEHw==) reports that at least 20% of mail-in ballots were cast illegally. Without mail-in ballots, we would have coasted to a big victory. That would have been consistent with polls that had me up by as much as 12% in the last week of the election.
Like Ronald Reagan and Abraham Lincoln, who also lost their first elections, I will use the lessons learned in 2022 to win in 2024. Here's how...
* Republicans must embrace early voting, mail-in voting, and voter assistance. Until we can change the laws, we will use them to our advantage. Republican leaders, at all levels, are encouraging us to "bank our vote" by voting early.
* Personal contact with Republicans who didn't vote. Titus' margin of victory over me and the Libertarian candidate was just over 7,000 votes, yet 46,000 registered Republicans did not vote. We have their contact information and an army of volunteers to encourage them to vote in '24.
* Capitalize on our momentum. Democrats are not excited about a dazed and confused Joe Biden or his strongest supporter, Dina Titus. Republicans are excited and energized to support President Donald Trump and expand our majority in Congress. We will capitalize on this enthusiasm and momentum by getting more people involved in our Get Out the Vote (GOTV) efforts.
* Expand our base. In 2022, we spent a lot of time in our Hispanic communities. A large percentage of the votes I received came from independent and non-partisan voters. We will double our outreach efforts to bring voters into our coalition.
The last election was the first time I've run for public office. Voters now know who I am. We will capitalize on the goodwill, name recognition, and lessons learned in 2022 to win in 2024.
Please reply to this email to join our Army of Volunteers to put America first and take back our country!

name: Congressman Paul Broun
subject: Sign the petition to ban transgender child mutilation
body:
Ban Child Mutilation Nationwide

Dear Concerned American,

Should so-called doctors be allowed to
sexually mutilate or chemically sterilize children - even
children as young as 8 years for girls and 10 years for boys?

Should publicly-funded schools be permitted
to promote this radical trans-sexual abuse often behind the backs
of parents?

I hope you say ABSOLUTELY NOT!

Yet it is happening every day in America. In
fact, an insider report from a horrified worker at a Missouri
Children's Hospital revealed that the number of children sent for
"gender transition" has increased by more than 400% in the last
five years.

That's why I'm emailing you today asking you
to sign your petition to your U.S. Representative and Senators
demanding they take immediate action to ban the transgender child
sexual mutilation and chemical castration procedures.

I am former U.S. Congressman Paul Broun, and
I'm more determined than ever to stop the worldwide tide of
Leftism I see targeting our children and grandchildren.

CitizenGO represents millions of members and
supporters fighting back against the radical anti-family LGBT
ideology that has swept through our schools, media, and
entertainment, mercilessly attacking the relationships between
children and their parents and destroying family morality and
faith.

Will you join with millions of pro-family
Citizens to defend our children from transgender child sexual
mutilation?

Click here to sign the petition to Congress
demanding they ban all gender transition procedures for minors
immediately!

Puberty blockers, hormone supplements, and
drastic sexual organ surgery are all procedures with horrific
side effects that children cannot fully grasp. And in a sea of
lies and misinformation, few adults understand the true horror.

Make no mistake, the transgender lobby wants
them confused and isolated from any dissenting voices.

*** I've seen an entire generation of youth
come out of their schools confused and assaulted by the
transgender ideology attacking gender and their sense of self,
persuading them to seek poisonous and severely harmful procedures
to change their bodies to "fit in" with the transgender world.

*** I've seen families torn to pieces as the
newest generation of children, who are fed radical transgender
values with their cereal, clash with bewildered parents over a
child's so-called" gender identity."

*** In a growing number of States, children
are encouraged to hide their planned mutilations or chemical
castrations from their parents by teachers and counselors.

*** Meanwhile, the transgender lobby rabidly
shuts down or "cancels" any dissenting voices or studies on the
harmful effects of child sexual mutilation.

*** They even more rabidly suppress any study
of the massive number of children who abandon gender transition
after the fact...

... and are left with bitter regrets, twisted
bodies and awful consequences.
The best way to put a stop to it all is by
passing a flat-out Federal ban on administering these procedures
to minors.

Our children, the most vulnerable members of
our society, are being conned into irreversible procedures that
alter their bodies and lives forever.

This is not a matter of choice or identity -
it's a matter of safety and common sense. Minors are not equipped
with the life experience or emotional maturity to make such
grave, scarring, and often irreversible decisions about their
bodies and their futures.

Sign your petition today demanding Congress
step in and protect our children from transgender mutilation.

Over 20 states have already passed bans on
transgender child sexual mutilation, though many are being
challenged in court.

But states like California and New York will
not follow suit willingly, and the transgender lobby is howling
for blood at the restrictions being placed on them.

That's why, once you've signed, I ask you to
chip in with a modest contribution to help CitizenGO bring other
Americans into the fight against child sexual mutilation. Even a
gift of $10 or $25 will be a big boost.

The success of this campaign relies on the
power of Citizens standing together to make our voices heard, and
every extra dollar counts when we're fighting to counter the
transgender lobby's pervasive ideology.

So please, sign your petition, share, and
chip in with a quick $10 or $25 contribution to help CitizenGO
recruit more signers and win the fight.

In addition to recruiting more petition
signers to increase the impact of our campaign, your contribution
will help fund:

Hard-hitting advertisements to highlight
and draw attention to the horrible practices of transgender
centers.
Targeted petition deliveries to key
elected officials demanding they take action to defend children.
Phone calls to likely supporters to raise
awareness and recruit new members.
Radio and TV ads exposing everything the
transgender ideology is inflicting on our children, should funds
permit.

So once you have signed, I ask that you
make a contribution of $10 or $25 to CitizenGO, or perhaps an
even more generous gift of $50 or $100, to help expand their
recruitment and to fund all of these plans in CitizenGO's fight
to stop child sexual mutilation.

So please sign your petition, share, and chip
in with a generous contribution of $10 or $25, or perhaps an even
more generous gift of $50 or $100 today.

Thank you for standing with us in this
crucial fight for our children's future.

Sincerely,

Paul C. Broun (MD)
U.S. Congressman Georgia 10 Ret.

P.S. I'm more determined than ever to stop
the worldwide tide of Leftism I see targeting our children and
grandchildren.

CitizenGO represents millions of members and
supporters fighting back against the radical anti-family LGBT
ideology, and I want every pro-sanity American to band together
to put a stop to child sexual mutilation and chemical castration.

The best way to do that is with a Federal ban
on performing Transgender procedures on minors, and CitizenGO is
launching a campaign to do just that. But it will take people
power to succeed.

That's why I'm counting on you to sign your
petition, and then go on to add a modest $10 or $25
contribution, or perhaps an even more generous gift of $50 or
$100, to help CitizenGO fight to ban child sexual mutilation.

In addition to signing your petition and
donating, I need you to share it with your friends and family who
share our values so they can have the opportunity to sign as
well. CitizenGO's petition page makes it super easy to share in a
way you prefer.

CitizenGO is a community of
active citizens that works to ensure that human life, the family
and our freedoms are respected worldwide. CitizenGO members live
in every nation of the world. Our team is spread across 16
countries on 5 continents and operates in 12 languages. Learn
about CitizenGO here or follow us on Facebook or Twitter.

Not produced or emailed at
taxpayer expense.

Peter, It’s time we end Measure 110.
Measure 110 decriminalized the possession of hard drugs such as meth, heroin, and fentanyl in Oregon - _**It’s time to put an end to these leftist Portland policies.**_
It’s time we re-criminalize hard drug possession offenses.

Hello Friend, Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return? _When we all get to Heaven, what a day of rejoicing that will be!_ _When we all see Jesus, we 'll sing and shout the victory!_ The words of this old hymn say it perfectly ... Christ's return is going to be glorious! **But between now and then, how should we live**? What does God's Word say about end times? As the world grows increasingly sinful ... **what should our response be?**
---
| | When I have those kinds of questions, I turn to the book of Revelation, which I've found helps provide answers and strength in these dark days. And today, I'm pleased to offer you my verse-by-verse study of the book of Revelation entitled _Final Conquest._ Final Conquest is my first commentary on the book of Revelation. It's all about the return of Jesus Christ, the most hope-filled event in human history. This book will help you face the future with confidence! God doesn't want you to live in fear. Final Conquest will unpack God's plan as never before -- you'll be encouraged!

body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history,

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=130e35b50f8348f48cfdaa7e74be3018&_e=eOOnCW9ps1LC0Nknx1k28OeZQowGoZ0QASufoVCVhPB93QHati-mUZbrRP-H_AittrK86lzyWwiQDGo6BHzeTgzwHdJr_TlhnIQzpgMfdR1-St_ME2VJ-MtVdsx_DaW2A3JvQUvM4YD9A4zhkHj4TnsJ73Pb3FYD7NKMRaiXZ-FJsJjlLJEsqQcSkxsGTmsLRwCBty1r6T6CBFkyou2yxWVZOa5Qb_-8nVVCevwZlj89Cq17h6zXVgRhMmgG8X7u1DzmP4u9oeMK4878Kj9BwlragajEzXqcg_00lE4ddPDR_kEPjQPi_emJdW3VsHtWVjqxR-H2kZrHK7mLhELPBiABsztH2xphB7TL4H4dC-IXdAR-qL6QIYD-PSFenskB50nuxCUO-JpimmKGXsHCl0df97nJtCNM8_l_0NpzAik%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. Friend,

But then it all changed for a photo-opt.

In March of 2022, I and other female swimmers were forced to compete with a male, Lia Thomas. We watched as this male swam to a title, beating out Olympians and other record holders. Despite tying Lia to the 100th of a second, the NCAA denied me the trophy because the NCAA claimed it was necessary to have Lia Thomas hold the trophy while photos were being taken.

The radical left reduced everything I worked my entire life for down to a photo opt.

But that's not all...

I was forced to share locker rooms with a 6'4" man.

**_This is where the madness needs to end because it 's not just sports where the radical gender ideology movement is dominating_.**

## Congress Warns of "National Security Threat"
Members of Congress asked the White House Wednesday to declassify information on what they described as [a "national security threat"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO4yAQQL8Gd0TDBGxfQXGNu1x7pUXwEOZEIIK5RPn71W67Wz896en9veyXwIXr7U-4k5fU9hCFn7SjNk6j3e10-ESEdJ7ImwVWgGWZlyl7gHgYB7-ADLnZGXONDqK5wpwirAtM7BHQAhpnwM3WnA5YMTm8rmc7p-RIWaCDpfXTv8ZVMqXybk_qp9juU_FZ5DHU-bfCTeEmmTKX8skUbpVeo5AI9aFwOyhRHaRrEG41FD0o_u8sb4WbtfO6AOhXGJnrTVrVnUKUoaXp2N8P4fhd1JI7BVG4Td0fjxeXwmNelIXbPfBXxSQ__voIAAD__xZObks) that the public should know about, while also saying there was no reason to panic. But because it was still classified, that couldn't be confirmed. House Intelligence Committee Chairman Mike Turner [called on the Biden administration](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2O5CAQBOCnwRlWg38vcHATOJvTZRtaDG7GvYvBgvagefuVN96oSqqk9H3cl7shT-H5z-w4sYuLsUwvXLRUndTt0lbr5BA1NhVOaoARYBj6odombKBbLWA_gFIAxjagB3C9fbgRRvxT0aRBt6BVp6DrW1WvMGrX6cfYtL1zHYoWcCWOqf6MFHhD59_xham2ca_8tDEfWTR_hZ6Fnksp9Z7DtQk9Y5BnFnoOWK44oicme1WOh0x4nA9P1gRZTApZRiczJopnlsEwxWC8zGjPRPyWvCU0LJMJX5eELBsxyi2eGYWeTZK3m6LNw_8qTetRyHvK_SBaeO6G_M9Z_pXuOwAA__8vVXJp) to declassify the intelligence, while others warned that publicizing it in this veiled way was likely to spark panic that wasn't warranted.

Dear Friend,

Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I'm reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like "_Does God exist? Can we know God?_ " with my students.

These questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in our relationship with each other and with God. [ ](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7d90eab417aa433eb74ffeefa38c8a4f&_e=jcRJ1EFyb8ELftCbnmzOrZ0tgHM35OiXELCA7_bqHgrIkpXKxMyG_pdwESOfEwoUpRFGnOymAYQlyYsTPta7EM631UlArPbEDZ1eAGdGnfu5foqpk2uij1Oe0gGPZqeQiUq3s7eqnk1uZsb_v073yD1RzP8oEQav5D32P_GlqS9Dl2iJz8OCGqQgPrITxnVttdHqBhvYPLqSbXNZH5CXGtHYTobctnvdplyTWbkheUzy4drakYFduvGuLIeRjwtlONWJb8-4_9Iw1PwRX1x3etCcUjX_zGlM78PMdiSPA1_PhLUpdJ3N-yYRiK9L5jAHW0i78WHALehBV8eczXuVzFOM_bGKirDArNcuqHvT5dnUR6waOXYhVlozXlnipU3yjl29-q6qSfQMnkIupCc7ja6g1MbfNf64fJMkWzEdpfI%3D) Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, "Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,"**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7d90eab417aa433eb74ffeefa38c8a4f&_e=jcRJ1EFyb8ELftCbnmzOrZ0tgHM35OiXELCA7_bqHgrIkpXKxMyG_pdwESOfEwoUpRFGnOymAYQlyYsTPta7EM631UlArPbEDZ1eAGdGnfu5foqpk2uij1Oe0gGPZqeQiUq3s7eqnk1uZsb_v073yD1RzP8oEQav5D32P_GlqS9Dl2iJz8OCGqQgPrITxnVttdHqBhvYPLqSbXNZH5CXGtHYTobctnvdplyTWbkheUzy4drakYFduvGuLIeRjwtlONWJb8-4_9Iw1PwRX1x3ep3gmwoHxbAWBLKVqXx9B64LmXIlxs6Uk0eu3a45k_6HCO13nP64ETBl5OEoqIJmfJfxXhfe3kF7ifZM59dG6peSitndnqcccTJ__DNElgHaoG5bkFxRwvHf8wl5FZBRCcYWOeWewPneOSzMIa7LN_c%3D) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me.

Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link: **[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-western-heritage-dvd](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7d90eab417aa433eb74ffeefa38c8a4f&_e=jcRJ1EFyb8ELftCbnmzOrZ0tgHM35OiXELCA7_bqHgrIkpXKxMyG_pdwESOfEwoUpRFGnOymAYQlyYsTPta7EM631UlArPbEDZ1eAGdGnfu5foqpk2uij1Oe0gGPZqeQiUq3s7eqnk1uZsb_v073yD1RzP8oEQav5D32P_GlqS9Dl2iJz8OCGqQgPrITxnVttdHqBhvYPLqSbXNZH5CXGtHYTobctnvdplyTWbkheUzy4drakYFduvGuLIeRjwtlONWJb8-4_9Iw1PwRX1x3eoQjkh22lCH-uE6qCEQEXNsdyn-Uk6fIfG29eMQhbsC3J-JfoC3CgoxWX_fbcfiEefXCCu2f-pzITt--QCQr1LZGd4cfzqsjDOkJzck8su8NaAhcdxQIbCCO2Qmo5_BPQHPgGK6fa7E62oK4kF0_cQg%3D)**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

Dear Friend,

Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I'm reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like "_Does God exist? Can we know God?_ " with my students.

These questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in our relationship with each other and with God. [ ](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=838c189150b04854a26bf99bab84280d&_e=3q326LJWJH52KKo_fcrqUYeN8Ba-xJzr_Zk4rrOnca7x9G4vWbefWobYNADqi5IZEvmzDJp3KrFTYkp_t_DMtK1tAACy2PBdV3rqthhxP738_5i_XZ-DxetugUbjU-h5F9AWBvvctUznKowDQycop4dodYAE2_CWJmagU-yrHNx9ZZjApkTnXXh4J774UyxViWVB29aXbx2hOTDviPmI1TUEb1kmH1zzxAQJfIWMbBgn4SVgJ_UBBWqE05G2KLzzIxOP01n80o1VxkUBKIc1W44uj96XFdLp1VlQXLd84SBOcsmK4_ikwo52OP0_WpRXBDGXTD9eWxdtHGyAnpVqEBFWq0V38D25sDDals4F1ntqh3ZfZd6ZPZy6ZAE8tk7x4LjGBIGi5_4dnsi4WEQC_wU7BZaQK_IZ6AjdTEGY-Dc%3D) Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, "Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,"**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=838c189150b04854a26bf99bab84280d&_e=3q326LJWJH52KKo_fcrqUYeN8Ba-xJzr_Zk4rrOnca7x9G4vWbefWobYNADqi5IZEvmzDJp3KrFTYkp_t_DMtK1tAACy2PBdV3rqthhxP738_5i_XZ-DxetugUbjU-h5F9AWBvvctUznKowDQycop4dodYAE2_CWJmagU-yrHNx9ZZjApkTnXXh4J774UyxViWVB29aXbx2hOTDviPmI1TUEb1kmH1zzxAQJfIWMbBgn4SVgJ_UBBWqE05G2KLzzIxOP01n80o1VxkUBKIc1W_idbuukDapWwTPOixfGAzOEFAYXqKg6ZbvLgsXuym7k9zFr5jexncJyRQZzlNkZJisJYn6Yg4vn4JHCmMFR7hbLJqp2_wIjJ7P1ee_YoM43PZyRYuIQ-hSALmWTcmmm6ntqFlvK4MB3AFuvxm4wFTA%3D) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me.

Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link: **[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-western-heritage-dvd](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=838c189150b04854a26bf99bab84280d&_e=3q326LJWJH52KKo_fcrqUYeN8Ba-xJzr_Zk4rrOnca7x9G4vWbefWobYNADqi5IZEvmzDJp3KrFTYkp_t_DMtK1tAACy2PBdV3rqthhxP738_5i_XZ-DxetugUbjU-h5F9AWBvvctUznKowDQycop4dodYAE2_CWJmagU-yrHNx9ZZjApkTnXXh4J774UyxViWVB29aXbx2hOTDviPmI1TUEb1kmH1zzxAQJfIWMbBgn4SVgJ_UBBWqE05G2KLzzIxOP01n80o1VxkUBKIc1WwxLFgDdi6iYTsKs5rjauu4HZGclkpswFF2j0thP8aHU94mdVc20pnyaimGQqSsGvq3D4AK8HKhK-d80JeN13kupnIfEI6K6i8tx6OMurnjOHTHj99PWvBm8ZWeYxBx0a2bHMBi9iWeNd1O4Abx4GIA%3D)**

body:
want to tell you why it’s critical for us to take back our culture and education from the radical left...

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0bbaf9a330e24a668eb4f6df2ebe1964&_e=8wb4-8VebVmBW_uqLzNAedQ9TC6BisI24iNNOB18IYCOEF5PUVeDNJYVWfNcU-yw01FtZ5wNeNr7miGbmzqRLnE6YMmZwCIvnYHl2WogJFZuvJ5tieU-oB0kPVwtZZASGsu58WOxEQZFlUtsitthmxSNQlLzP1Vsvo62-52ZVAIt36MkR6naLpfhO6yT13CPXIFPkppG6I8-Cwk5qR0UnhQzF09CbW6z19e_Jf0GYUkOc03g1B6ot-L_I6MqubqxbF4r0PdaymVHN3QAJVq6dAodGse6W299oNbYr2sjUQw9QFWISKpPnJohQcQN-NfKf2d7ETE_FQdGCURhw68JOaqa7MBaUShS2-hQoH0aYhM%3D "SkyTree Book Fairs")

Friend,

This is a deeply personal email, but I want to tell you why it's critical for us to take back our culture and education from the radical left... not just in sports, but even in children's books.

My story begins at the University of Kentucky. I was on the swim team. I am a 12-time NCAA all-American, 5x SEC champion, and SEC record holder in the butterfly.

But then it all changed for a photo-opt.

In March of 2022, I and other female swimmers were forced to compete with a male, Lia Thomas. We watched as this male swam to a title, beating out Olympians and other record holders. Despite tying Lia to the 100th of a second, the NCAA denied me the trophy because the NCAA claimed it was necessary to have Lia Thomas hold the trophy while photos were being taken.

The radical left reduced everything I worked my entire life for down to a photo opt.

But that's not all...

I was forced to share locker rooms with a 6'4" man.

**_This is where the madness needs to end because it 's not just sports where the radical gender ideology movement is dominating_.**

Now, children's literature is injected with this radical gender ideology movement.

[You can help me STOP this madness by making an urgent donation to SkyTree Book Fairs, which is combating Scholastic's transgender woke propaganda, by creating a wholesome and age-appropriate book fair alternative for parents, students, and educators. Click here to donate ANY amount!](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0bbaf9a330e24a668eb4f6df2ebe1964&_e=8wb4-8VebVmBW_uqLzNAedQ9TC6BisI24iNNOB18IYCOEF5PUVeDNJYVWfNcU-yw01FtZ5wNeNr7miGbmzqRLnE6YMmZwCIvnYHl2WogJFZuvJ5tieU-oB0kPVwtZZASGsu58WOxEQZFlUtsitthmxSNQlLzP1Vsvo62-52ZVAIt36MkR6naLpfhO6yT13CP8YCiR_i4f_HmlNC3jvk6Y4hv7GHFCF4dgntajE5s58uwip1qcw8712IkFgSBPkjV5_GJL3Cu1UVOIB7YJi76H18RT_zSwzwJrzKzy8pFUlqOmsoBJQDx4gwYB0I5xJxp-7UCaMV0W72Lh4L0bBYWzNz3TKIF9u38JTVkUOHqWS4%3D)

Some of the books are too gross to even share with you on this email. But here are pages from "Welcome to St. Hell," a 2022 Scholastic book glamorizing gender transitioning to middle schoolers.

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0bbaf9a330e24a668eb4f6df2ebe1964&_e=8wb4-8VebVmBW_uqLzNAedQ9TC6BisI24iNNOB18IYCOEF5PUVeDNJYVWfNcU-yw01FtZ5wNeNr7miGbmzqRLnE6YMmZwCIvnYHl2WogJFZuvJ5tieU-oB0kPVwtZZASGsu58WOxEQZFlUtsitthmxSNQlLzP1Vsvo62-52ZVAIt36MkR6naLpfhO6yT13CPJBBdTuWmHnuFjF6KTtsJu0PlpOhiS4Dk39hdMN4SpRO8N_6nqzKoRHtTQ3-J3uVkeWZrwscz4ZUodWx2l7FwvZtWNabTDMPbly11KPN9GwgQAUj5iuk7gfyrMPMKRt9U4gYoVtecoUsY3pPg03ZY62obAT84KJmbICsHL-v9C7k%3D)

Full stop: This needs to end. No compromising. No more excuses.

While Scholastic holds a virtual monopoly on school book fairs, one organization is fighting back, and I am urgently asking for you to support them as you have supported my fight to defend women's sports.

Trading is the most rewarding skill you could learn.

Trading is the most rewarding skill you could learn. If you know what you’re doing, it’s possible to stack $100 bills high.
It could mean paying off your debts...
Upgrading your lifestyle...
Retiring securely. And living happily ever after.
Sounds great till you see this statistic...
80% of people who start trading blow up their account and in frustration quit within two years.

subject: Why most traders quit in two years
body:
Trading is the most rewarding skill you could learn.

Trading is the most rewarding skill you could learn. If you know what you’re doing, it’s possible to stack $100 bills high.
It could mean paying off your debts...
Upgrading your lifestyle...
Retiring securely. And living happily ever after.
Sounds great till you see this statistic...
80% of people who start trading blow up their account and in frustration quit within two years.
My name is Thomas Wood. I’ve worked on Wall Street at Medallion Financial, a wealth management firm with over $1 billion in assets. And made hedge-fund partner at Supero Capital, at age 25. It’s been a 15-year ride. I made my fortune.
Now my mission is training new traders. I want to shift you out of the 80% failure group into the 20% of traders that consistently multiply your money.

[SIGN THE PETITION](https://www.kennedy24.com/border-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_2_15_24_email_1rs_2_a&n=5)
Dear Peter,
The crisis at the border has reached unimaginable proportions, with devastating consequences for our nation.
The body bags keep piling up. Drugs and human trafficking run rampant. Our cities and towns are overrun and strained to the max. The number of illegal migrants in the United States has roughly _DOUBLED_ under President Biden.
Last night, Biden's own Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas was impeached by the House of Representatives for his failure to enforce border laws. This unprecedented move underscores the urgency and severity of the situation we face.
Our country is on the brink of being lost, and we cannot afford to remain silent any longer.
[That’s why I’m asking you to sign this petition demanding President Biden secure the border now. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/border-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_2_15_24_email_1rs_2_a&n=6)
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://www.kennedy24.com/border-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_2_15_24_email_1rs_2_a&n=7)
Under his watch, the number of people taken into custody by the U.S. Border Patrol has reached an average of 2 million per year — the highest levels in the agency’s 100-year history.
President Biden continues to play chicken with our lives and refuses to use executive authority to secure the border. _In fact, he walked back many of the restrictions that were keeping the crisis under control._
_This is a deliberate political move._
President Biden has held office for 50 years — he’s playing dumb when he pretends he doesn’t know what to do. He’s playing politics when he ties border security to overseas war funding.
It’s egregious that in the United States __we have illegal migrants sleeping in hotels while veterans sleep on the street__.
Enough is enough.
[Sign this petition demanding President Biden secure the border.](https://www.kennedy24.com/border-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_2_15_24_email_1rs_2_a&n=8)

Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

name: Bill Spadea
subject: THEY PULLED THE BILL, WE WON!
body:
Peter, I've got incredible news that proves when we unite, our voices can move mountains... Thanks to YOU and the tireless
|
---
| Peter, **I've got incredible news that proves when we unite, our voices can move mountains...** Thanks to YOU and the tireless efforts of grassroots groups across New Jersey, we've achieved a monumental victory: **Senate Bill 2421 (the horrifying "Freedom to Read" bill that we reached out to you about yesterday) has been pulled from today's agenda of the Senate Education Committee.** **This isn't just a win; it's a testament to the power of our collective action.** Our relentless calls, our unwavering resolve, and our dedication to protecting the innocence of our children made the difference. Senators Zwicker and Ruiz heard us loud and clear—their phones didn't stop ringing, and as a result, they pulled the bill. **This is what happens when the Common Sense Club and the people of New Jersey stand together against policies that threaten our core values and our kids' futures.** **_To each and every one of you who made your voice heard, thank you._** Your engagement has safeguarded the innocence of hundreds of thousands of children across our state. This victory is yours as much as it is ours. But let's not forget, this fight was won not just on the front lines but also on the airwaves. Through our media platforms and the Common Sense Club, we amplified your concerns, your calls for action, and your unwavering commitment to common sense values. **Together, we showed that our community is a force to be reckoned with.** As we celebrate this incredible win, let's also remember that our work isn't done. There will be more challenges ahead, more battles to fight, and more victories to win. And that's why I'm asking you to take the next step with us. If you are not an official member already, [**join the Common Sense Club today**](https://xtz223.keap-link015.com/v2/click/3f7e5474a51bd61f5c9cf5033188e00d/eJyNkE0LgkAQhv_LnM2P1aC8RYSI1iHqHItOuaXrsk5Zif-9taJTQdd5n3mGdzoglFxSnEMIV7oz5oMFGjOhBEqa15J49kzZOPB8z4JSyFOk67OCsPu6_AGGsTd1JxbQTaFBNuvZPIlX0S6NV4khFdfmxn-eiR98PIvlLE6h73-KsRK0uBh3AyHpMw6NcmFa0VaXhi-IVBM6Ttu29rEWkgrci0NBzGWBndWVgxUX5WiIjI0rhTJ_vyLB28vZPwAm9Gb6) and be an active part of a movement that truly makes a difference. Your membership doesn't just support our cause; it amplifies our voice, strengthens our efforts, and contributes to real, tangible change in New Jersey and beyond.

subject: CTA Feb 15: The Senate Must Hold a Trial
body:
The House impeached Mayorkas. It’s time to convict.
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot-

---
| The repeated actions and decisions of Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas have raised serious concerns about his ability to uphold the duties and responsibilities of his office. He has refused to faithfully execute our laws and he has lied to Congress about his failures. In light of this, the US House of Representatives voted to impeach Secretary Mayorkas. This should now open up a trial within the Senate, where they have the opportunity to convict and remove the Secretary from office. We believe this trial is crucial to ensure accountability and protects the integrity of our government institutions. His handling of the immigration crisis at our southern border has demonstrated a lack of competence and a disregard for the citizens of America. However, Senate Democrats want to handle this in a partisan way and protect their colleague, rather than doing what is best for the country. **We need your support to make our voices heard and demand the necessary actions to address this situation.** ************

2. **Spread the Word:** Share this email with your friends, family, and colleagues who may share our concerns. Encourage them to join the cause and make their voices heard. [**You can also read and share my op-ed about this.**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979469f6f09d/1edb979469f49c18 "You can also read and share my op-ed about this.")

3. **Contact Your Representatives:** Reach out to your elected officials and urge them to support the trial and conviction of Secretary Mayorkas. You can use our [**Align Act campaign**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979469f6f09d/1edb979469f49c1a) for this too!
We believe in the importance of holding our government officials accountable for their actions, and your support is crucial in achieving this goal. Together, we can ensure that our government operates with transparency, integrity, and in the best interests of the American people.
In liberty, Jenny Beth Martin ************

If you’re hearing from me for the first time today, here is a quick rundown of who I am, why I’m running, and why Unlike Joe Biden , I understand what it is to serve our country, not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I have been wounded in service of our nation. I’ve lost mentors and friends who willingly made the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. Like President Trump , I know our nation's best days are ahead of us. Like President Trump, I am sickened by the damage Democrats have inflicted upon our great Republic every day of Joe Biden’s presidency. Donald Trump knows that Montanans - and Americans across the country - want more conservative political outsiders representing their interests in the U.S. Senate. That’s why, on Friday, February 9th, he formally endorsed my campaign for the U.S. Senate. – and spend $100M plus in the process. As of last week, they’ve made public their plans to spend more than 56 million dollars attacking me on Montana airwaves later this year. Being a SEAL isn’t a one-person job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit to defeat the enemy. The Senate functions in much the same way. President Trump knows this, which is why he’s endorsed my campaign. Kristi Noem, Tommy Tuberville, Kellyanne Conway, Marjorie Taylor Greene .... and many others also know I’m the only conservative in the race who can beat Jon Tester and flip this seat. They’ve all endorsed my campaign in recent months. Republicans around the country know that to win back the Senate, we must flip Montana in the fall. But this won’t be an easy task; it will take thousands of hours working around the clock to get our message in front of every voter in Montana. But I can tell you this: Every ounce of sweat and tears we put into this campaign will be worth winning on November 5th. I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of evil. I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why I am determined to take on the anti-American, radical Left in Washington as Montana’s next U.S. Senator. We need a proven warrior to take back this Senate seat and take on the Democrats in Washington. I hope hearing my story proves I am the man for the job. For America's Future, Tim Sheehy Republican for U.S. Senate, Montana | " "I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. Peter Willis,Time is flying by. We are already a month and half into 2024. The November election will be here before you know it – less than 40 weeks away. Are you ready?We’re running full speed ahead and have just launched some new tools to help us succeed next fall. Our new [Social Media Took Kit](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=65ce629531d49548cbf1e831&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftombarrettforcongress.com%2Fsocial-media-toolkit%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D65ce249915120241e625adae%26ss_email_id%3D65ce629531d49548cbf1e831%26ss_campaign_name%3DBarrett%2BSITREP%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-02-15T19%253A14%253A48Z&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65ce249915120241e625adae&l=en-US&s=7sACqjib8dMSr8nLfhMCHtsEjaQ%3D) is live and you can see a preview of it below. Be sure to download your favorite Tom Barrett gif, profile pic, or graphics and post them to your social media page. Don’t be afraid to send any suggestions to help us make this site better! We have a lot of work ahead of us and we’re leaving no stone unturned in our efforts to flip the 7th District red in 2024. I’m on the trail every day talking to voters, touring businesses, and learning more about the issues important to the 7th District. Don’t wait until September or October to talk with your neighbors about the election. We must start now because Washington DC Democrats have their sights on this seat, and we can’t let them beat us. Thank you for standing with me,

_**Affordable prescription drugs need bipartisan patent reform**_ By Bobby Jindal and Charlie Katebi
---
Like food, gas, and other essential products, the public is now paying more for prescription drugs than ever before. In January alone, drug manufacturers raised the price of more than 910 major brand-name drugs by 5% on average, according to the drug price nonprofit 46Brooklyn Research. Between 2011 and 2021, America’s annual spending on prescription drugs increased 64%, from $366 billion to $603 billion. A major driver of the rising cost of prescription drugs is patent abuse.

America’s patent system is essential to promote new innovations that benefit everyone. In the case of drugs, patents are essential for developing lifesaving and life-improving medications. However, drug manufacturers are increasingly obtaining patents that do not advance new drugs or new innovations for existing drugs. Instead, they are obtaining patents to stymie generic competition so they can raise prices.

Patent abuses force patients to wait years and sometimes decades before they can purchase a cheaper generic version of an expensive brand-name drug. A 2021 analysis of the 12 bestselling drugs in the United States found that these drugs have an average of 74 patents. These patents force patients to wait 40 years before they can access a cheaper generic version of these drugs. ****[****FINISH READING ON WASHINGTONEXAMINER.COM****](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=9bf606cfd60e4771b940bc5d5eb25645&_e=dvdMumodsFBRkl_xNabuAwe099XXeVS3I22LAuFTbxR5gaJkZETFSVmipWD1MJUSo2AQ_0bnD7_o4RfKYyzaM2aN09oQomMmfx_lagb-78dmhzidbHzEG5Cu6ldbFLHEjMXFextmIABtrwbmTfhSaNNixJsReeYP5OknNyTVAuD1495wpGWKuBkOH87PsbiBWXNGKJtvww89YPYo5qtfriz6dWy8kQSGVnLoMbQHy-mbA3pKWKpkHuhKNC3SbAA4ANHs5Nt61eH53ZNHug7gaeEsMrqAfvFPbwdnGG4juXbrz4uRhXyehdo7Cr0VowoCp-ctcPRDrDBVEUP_4F1-iDAbrk0YbTRvirsFmkgyVt0%3D)****

subject: Why don't we elect people who care?
body:
My mother experienced something no mother should experience. | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mullenformontana/why-dont-we-elect-people-who-care?e=805e709ff8)
---
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=5c2e9818c6&e=805e709ff8)
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=b87e8dbbef&e=805e709ff8)
_Emily, left, Jesse James, middle, and Louis Mullen, Christmas 1986, opening stuffed Dinosaurs Grandma Mullen made._
Hey team, it’s Jesse James,
A warning: This email may be difficult for some to read.
Today is my little sister’s birthday. Emily was born three years after me – I was born in 1984, Louis in 1985, Emily in 1987, and Lloyd in 1988. Yes, we are Irish Catholic. Why do you ask?
If you remember my email from Sunday, there were three brothers in those photos, no sister.
My mother was seven months pregnant with my brother Lloyd when my sister died. Just before Mother’s Day, 1988, my sister suddenly became sick. My parents took me and Louis to the neighbor’s house while Emily went to the hospital where my mom worked. That was the last time I saw my sister.
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=0b4d0679c4&e=805e709ff8)
_My mom, about to graduate from nursing school._
Meningitis is a terrible disease
To say that was a formative moment during my childhood is an understatement.
Today, Meningitis is easily preventable. But thousands of Montana children were kicked off Medicaid in 2023 by Montana’s Republican Party. That and a rising anti-vaccine movement have me worried about the future of healthcare in our state.
Montana MUST elect reasonable and empathetic people who understand how important healthcare is to most Montanans.
I want you to talk to three people today who ignore politics. Please let them know how important these elections are. This isn’t just about a race to win Secretary of State and voter access. We need your support in the State House and Senate, where the future of our healthcare is decided. We still have many uncontested GOP seats and only a few weeks to find candidates. If you know someone who should run, please get in touch with the [MDLCC](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=a716e3e3d8&e=805e709ff8).
And if you can, [please donate](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=112400b608&e=805e709ff8) to this campaign, too.
Thank you,Jesse James Mullen

| [DONATE HERE](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=c94e42a2f2&e=805e709ff8)
---
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=b33783fc06&e=805e709ff8)
_My oldest daughter, Emily, the baby in this photo, was born 16 years and 11 months after the anniversary of my sister Emily’s passing. My mother raised her three boys and now has six granddaughters, one grandson, and one great-grandson. My mom is in the background of this photo, and her father, my grandfather, is holding his great-granddaughter, Emily._
|
---
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=238d959ebd&e=805e709ff8)

Like President Trump , I know our nation's best days are ahead of us. Like President Trump, I am sickened by the damage Democrats have inflicted upon our great Republic every day of Joe Biden’s presidency. Donald Trump knows that Montanans - and Americans across the country - want more conservative political outsiders representing their interests in the U.S. Senate. That’s why, on Friday, February 9th, he formally endorsed my campaign for the U.S. Senate. – and spend $100M plus in the process. As of last week, they’ve made public their plans to spend more than 56 million dollars attacking me on Montana airwaves later this year. Being a SEAL isn’t a one-person job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit to defeat the enemy. The Senate functions in much the same way. President Trump knows this, which is why he’s endorsed my campaign. Kristi Noem, Tommy Tuberville, Kellyanne Conway, Marjorie Taylor Greene .... and many others also know I’m the only conservative in the race who can beat Jon Tester and flip this seat. They’ve all endorsed my campaign in recent months. Republicans around the country know that to win back the Senate, we must flip Montana in the fall. But this won’t be an easy task; it will take thousands of hours working around the clock to get our message in front of every voter in Montana. But I can tell you this: Every ounce of sweat and tears we put into this campaign will be worth winning on November 5th. I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of evil. I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why I am determined to take on the anti-American, radical Left in Washington as Montana’s next U.S. Senator. We need a proven warrior to take back this Senate seat and take on the Democrats in Washington, Peter. I hope hearing my story proves I am the man for the job. For America's Future, Tim Sheehy Republican for U.S. Senate, Montana | " "I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY -- NOT POLITICS AS USUAL." | PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA Tim Sheehy is a former Navy SEAL.
