Greetings!,
Did you hear what just happened with the NCAA?
Last week, former general counsel for the U.S. Anti-Doping Agency William Bock III resigned from his post on the NCAA's Committee on Infractions.
Bock submitted his resignation letter citing the NCAA's policy to allow transgender-identifying men to compete in women's sports as his primary motivation for stepping down. This is a big deal.
This is the first in what we hope will be a consistent shift in protesting the NCAA and its woke policies.
The former committeeman said prior to his decision to step down that he consulted with experts in sports physiology and developmental biology to ensure he understood the science behind the issue. Ultimately after consulting experts he came to the conclusion that allowing biological men to participate in women's sports was morally and scientifically wrong.
Famously, the NCAA allowed transgender athlete Lia Thomas, a biological male, to compete in the women's swimming championships, taking a podium placement away from Kentucky All-American Riley Gaines.
---
| Now, Riley is one of the leading voices in pushing back against the anti-trans agenda and a great partner to APP's work in stopping this nonsense.
APP has been the leader in the fight to protect women's sports for years, and injecting this issue into the national narrative has only been possible because of you!
Let me be clear: the NCAA is nothing more than another woke entity pushing the Left's agenda to take opportunities away from our daughters. Enough is enough.
[Can we count on you to continue supporting our efforts to protect women's sports?](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KMAPX5paNegIUMDH_k3WTsUawNSG76aX5CMZXMd3Vf-5hr72Whb5QiXWY-IX-QFQTRfsU5eoDJDBeRXnUuKYkrscygB26ZYKZxazUbjfkqa5Q5smtnFDBZshpPvBW7mDd5Ofr2EUOqHrg2W3fATSaCUISdu-mFZZcrpqrfvdq80s1AZUdBnAQ6BtLins26Qnj9myyTY0sV0VrLa3wuDjXW7YZYjcAYoI&c=V168URbmHwfBRSjj331WNzSuW1-tOwl7okh5Bs2PUJeKQ3jqY62RLQ==&ch=A7CcLMMTLqzpRzN43MB8dwYRWm2yMaJpUpvvzW132bqb-WcKRQfc3g==)

| | | Donald Trump and his lawyers are claiming that he has "total immunity" for any crimes committed as president. They are even going so far as to claim he could order US troops to assassinate a political rival. The claim is preposterous, it's simply meant as a delay tactic, and the Supreme Court shouldn't waste time on motions and filings and arguments -- it should reject it out of hand, let the lower court's ruling stand, and allow the trial to proceed. [**Add your name: Tell the Supreme Court to Immediately Reject Trump's "Total Immunity" Claim**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0561999b-170d-4fe9-865e-a5b80e6c8d74/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) The Supreme Court does not have an obligation to spend time on every case, regardless of how absurd it is. If Trump claimed he was immune, because he was actually a unicorn, and magical creatures can't be prosecuted by human courts, we wouldn't waste time on it. And we shouldn't waste time on this claim, which is also just plain absurd. [**Add your name: Tell the Supreme Court to Immediately Reject Trump's "Total Immunity" Claim**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T37d938ae-d4cf-48aa-8d46-8d031dacbf32/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

_And I have a critical question for you_ :
**_Do you believe that Judicial Watch 's full range of election integrity work...lawsuits, research and investigations... _should be our top priority for 2024_?_**
I need to know your opinion!
If you think our election integrity work _should_ be our top priority, [I urge you to let me know and make a contribution today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=67086&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) to help us take on all the election challenges confronting us!

Since 2012, we've fought successfully to protect honest election safeguards...like going to bat for states defending their voter ID laws; and forcing states to make reasonable efforts to keep their voter rolls accurate...work the Justice Department should actually be doing..._but_ _isn 't_.

Our lawsuits and settlements have resulted in the removal of more than **4 MILLION** deceased, non-citizen, moved or otherwise ineligible voters from voter lists in more than a dozen red states _and_ blue states across the country.

That's not all...

* We've provided expert testimony on a number of occasions before **Congress** in opposition to leftist power grabs (led by Biden administration officials and a network of Soros groups) to "federalize" our elections and put the corrupt Justice Department in control of administering elections.

* We successfully sued **Maryland** and overturned the Democratic legislature's hyper-partisan, election-rigging "gerrymander" scheme.

* We're in **Illinois** fighting in federal court to block the state's efforts to open the floodgates to voter fraud by allowing mail-in ballots to arrive and be counted up to 14 days after Election Day!

Team,
It’s February 15th, and tonight marks the official mid-point of our quarter. So I am reaching out to you personally with an update on our mid-quarter fundraising progress.
When my team emailed you yesterday about our mid-quarter deadline, we weren't quite sure how much support we would get — or whether we'd reach our goals ahead of tonight's critical fundraising drive.
But we have a solid chance.
It started with Helga from Playa del Rey with a $10 donation. Then John from Hudson City joined with their $20. And later, Joseph from Tigard chipped in $5.
Now they're all hoping that you will join them, and I am too. Because there's only one way we'll continue powering our movement for changemaking candidates...if we work together.
I know that $3 doesn't seem like the kind of money that can help us hold the Senate majority and win back the House, but this team has won big victories before — in the Wisconsin Supreme Court Race and the Virginia State Senate race — and I have no doubt we can do it again.
Whether it be unseating Ted Cruz in Texas, replacing Krysten Sinema in Arizona, or re-electing Tammy Baldwin in Wisconsin, we have the power to create meaningful change if we work together. Because it all adds up when everyone is chipping in.
So I am asking you directly:

The California Democratic Party’s Organizing Department is excited to highlight the stories of our staff members who are passionate about making a difference throughout our state.
From leading our organizing efforts to connecting with local community leaders, our organizing team is working in every corner of California to ensure we continue to elect Democrats up and down the ballot.
cadem.org/takeaction [cadem.org/takeaction]
Welcome, Spring Interns!
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/7344676C7469533165506B59697974444C47644B664448317162595850573170347476417571557A46636C49356579304C71544E375062746758706F6331525A/editor_images/CANVASS%20ACTION%20MOBILIZE%20%28Instagram%20Post%29-7.jpg]
Welcome! To our Spring Intern Cohort for our Youth Vote Engagement Program this semester.
Look out for these local leaders working to uplift Democratic voices in our targeted congressional districts.
Frank Martinez - University of California Berkeley
Frank first became an organizer and Democrat as a youth vote outreach intern during the 2016 election with the Coalition for Humane immigration Rights Los Angeles (CHIRLA).
His work as an organizer is fueled by a passion for advocating for undocumented immigration rights, along with supporting initiatives related to reproductive rights, and the climate crisis.
Lucy Dixon - University of California Santa Barbara
Lucy first became a Democrat because of where she lives. Growing up in Clovis, Lucy was exposed to extreme conservative viewpoints, pushing her to explore opposite values.
She is most passionate about getting underrepresented communities out to vote, making sure that anyone who wants to vote is easily able to.
Osbaldo Leon - University of California Merced
Osbaldo first became a Democrat because he realized how beneficial the social safety net is for many families in his communities, and how it is currently being threatened.
He wants voters to feel seen, and not neglected by their representatives, and he is most passionate about tackling disinformation and providing voter education online.
Alvina Miguel-Leon - California State University Fresno
Alvina's journey as an organizer and Democrat is rooted in her passion for social justice, healthcare accessibility, environmental justice, and community engagement.
She is committed to creating a positive impact in her community and advocating for change.
India Buenrostro - Madera Community College
India began organizing as a volunteer during the pandemic, attending multiple rallies and marches. Pursuing equality for every citizen led her to participate in the Democratic Party.
Today, she is most passionate about addressing social inequalities, farmworkers' protections, intersectional feminism, and child safety.

The California Democratic Party is a volunteer based organization! Our community activists are committed year-round to work with our organizing team to get out the vote and protect our democracy. CADEM is thrilled to highlight our local volunteers who continue to do their part in the Forever Organizing work.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/796C6D35456D34567841636E4E5931464A62353730556366752F454E5A2F4D4A37393436433264446E7379356C71563064494C4F704A44316A61367337537466/editor_images/20240123_170219.jpg]
Elle Kurpiewski
Democratic Headquarters of the Desert
Elle was born in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, the daughter of a career USAF officer.
She lives in Rancho Mirage and volunteers as the Political Director of the Democratic Headquarters of the Desert, which she helped open in 2008.
Elle is a retired United Airlines Flight Attendant and she was active in her union, the Association of Flight Attendants (AFA-CWA), serving as the Legislative Affairs Chair, representing Southern California, Arizona and Nevada. A lifetime Democrat, she became the first flight attendant to run for Congress in 2002. Her activism stems from her union work.
As the Election year proceeds, her number one goal is to continue to keep the Headquarters open and provide whatever is needed to elect Democrats from the top to the bottom! The office has been a 16 year home for campaigns, coordinated efforts, volunteers, and to provide the space to answer questions, provide assistance with voter registration, and engage fellow Democrats. Those efforts continue not just locally but throughout Riverside County and with the California Democratic Party.
Providing a space for young and old to participate in having their voice heard is the goal of the Democratic Headquarters of the Desert, and the way Elle stays active.

We're exactly 19 days away from our March 5 primary election! While the polls close next month, voters across California will be receiving their ballots now.
Today more than ever, taking action with our Forever Organizing department will directly impact turnout in the most competitive regions in California.
Whether you're interested in calling voters, knocking on doors, hosting organizing actions with your Democratic club or group, or registering first time voters on college campuses, we're thrilled to be doing the good work with you.
Can we count on you to join us for an organizing action this month? Your efforts could mean the difference between winning and losing battleground congressional districts this year.

Are you in a safe blue district, but hope to get involved to win back our House majority this year?
Introducing our Adopt-a-District program!
You can join our organizing actions from anywhere, taking action to win targeted districts from the comfort of your own home, or you can take action in person at our canvass events!
By adopting a targeted district, you will mobilize and energize voters in neighborhoods with the biggest impact on taking back our House majority next year.
Sign up below, and you'll be identified as an official partner of our organizing efforts in the targeted district. After joining us, we'll be in touch to share how you can take immediate action with us from anywhere.

Making calls is an easy way to take action from home. Whether it’s your first time making calls or you’re a veteran phone banker, we need your help!
This is one of the most important moments of our lifetime and we’re going to need all hands on deck to ensure our voices are heard. This is a time for immediate action and we need it to be known that California unambiguously supports Democrats up-and-down the ballot and rejects extremist, anti-democratic ideology!

body:
| When I first ran for Senate in 2012, a lot of powerful people didn’t think I had a shot
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2021%2E35263%2E2eMG9Y)
Peter — When I first ran for Senate in 2012, a lot of powerful people didn’t think I had a shot. They thought there was no way Wisconsin would send an openly gay woman to the U.S. Senate. That didn’t matter to me though, because I only had one goal: to fight as hard as I could to make a real difference in people’s lives. I also knew that I had an incredible grassroots team behind me, and I had faith we could accomplish anything together. Thanks to this team, I became the first woman elected to the United States Senate from Wisconsin and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. And I’ve been fighting every day since to protect and expand LGBTQ+ rights, defend our democracy, make health care accessible and affordable, and so much more. But there are threats on the horizon putting all the progress we’ve made in jeopardy. Republicans only need to flip two seats to take the Senate majority, and our race is one of their top targets. Wisconsin is known for its competitive elections, and the GOP is willing to spend tens of millions to defeat me. There are multiple right-wing megamillionaires preparing to jump into this race. **Every single contribution makes a huge difference for our campaign — so I’m personally asking, Peter:** **[Can I count on you to make a $5 contribution before our mid-quarter deadline? body:
Will you help me strikeout the liberal lineup of Adam Schiff, Katie Porter, and Barbara Lee on March 5th?

| |
---
| | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zup4bvl16pmbi95fo9h3d1oinrv3khiooneui9n0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j64or4chh2bs)
---
| | Friend, **[**Will you help me strikeout the liberal lineup of Adam Schiff, Katie Porter, and Barbara Lee on March 5th?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z72ca0o33ac1rihit2nt8vohpck1cain7p0ck4kg_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j64or4chh2bs)** That’s the day of the California primary. The top two go head-to-head in November.I can think of only one thing worse than a General Election ballot that forces Californians to “choose” between three dyed-in-the-wool leftists like Schiff, Porter, or Lee......and that’s being forced to endure six years of Schiff, Porter, or Lee in the U.S. Senate. I need your help to go “three up...three down” against this lineup of liberal career politicians.That’s a bit of baseball vernacular.No surprise, right?It means you record three outs against the first three batters in an inning.Then, it’s your team’s turn to go on offense. Well, that’s very much the case in this election... ...you and I need to strike out this lineup of liberals so we can get to work saving our country.Liberals straight out of Congress where all three have spent a combined 51 years – most recently acting as rubberstamps for the Biden agenda that has done so much harm to our state and our nation. Which is why I’m reaching out to you today.**[Will you step up and help strike out this “lineup of liberals” through a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6iu4ukahn410lvlsp6uvic831ephc7tgnr0a2u0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j64or4chh2bs)** Think about the crumbling quality of life in my once-great state of California.Think about the daily reality of:
---
• Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California.• Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don’t lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction.
---
If you believe, as I do, that voters deserve better than a “false choice” between Schiff, Porter, and Lee on November 5, 2024, **[**then I need you to take immediate action and rush a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6jv0jqbdfpamfkur7ig2qg629q25uqmm385asp0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j64or4chh2bs)** Winning this election requires a one-two punch:
---
1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign “connecting the dots” between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day.
---
In my playing days, I would never be out-worked or out-hustled. That’s my approach to this campaign. Door-knocks, phone-calls, rallies, townhalls, you name it. **[But I need your help. I’d consider it a great honor to have you on my campaign team. I also consider your support a must have in order to win this race.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvc2lrrsms8an6boeh51891qotfn2c9c8ud5429o_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j64or4chh2bs)** With you on our side, I’m confident we can not only give voters a real choice, but someone who remembers how great California was and knows how great it can be again.
---
| | With deepest appreciation,
---
---
Steve GarveyRepublican for United States Senate

---
My campaign is focused on quality-of-life issues, public safety, and education. As your U.S. Senator, I will serve with commonsense, compassion, and will work to build consensus to benefit all of the people of California.I’ve been fortunate to wear many hats in life – from professional athlete to businessman to philanthropist. But the one thing that has remained consistent is my love for this great state and my desire to make a difference.In baseball, it’s not about the individual; it’s about the team. I believe the same holds true for politics. It’s time we come together, find common ground, and work towards a brighter future.

We must unify our state and nation.

I care deeply about our nation's future and I know we can win in New Mexico!

# OUR CHANCE FOR CHANGE!

Dear Friend,
As we gear up for the upcoming election, it's crucial to rally behind leaders who embody integrity, resilience, and a deep commitment to our community. That's why I'm excited to introduce you to Joseph Alfonso, a Marine veteran and dedicated Democrat vying to represent Michigan's 4th Congressional District.
With a background rooted in service to our country, Joseph brings a unique perspective to the table—one shaped by firsthand experiences and a profound understanding of the issues facing our nation. His unwavering dedication to serving others has earned him the respect and admiration of constituents across our district.
We invite you to join us in supporting Joseph Alfonso's campaign by clicking the links to our site to learn more about his platform and vision for our district. Together, we can drive positive change, championing the values that matter most to our community.
| [About Joseph](https://alfonsoforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bb75364011dcc8a637f1fdd6f&id=3f19128562&e=16d812e81c)
---
|
---
In 2022, when others hesitated to take the leap, we refused to stand idle. We recognized the call to action and decided to step up to the plate. While some may have doubted the competitiveness of Michigan's 4th Congressional District, we knew better.
We understood that true change starts with us, the people.There were those who doubted, and still doubt, the potential for change in our district. But their skepticism only fuels our determination. They seek to maintain the status quo, to ensure that only their chosen few hold power. But we refuse to let politics as usual dictate our future.
“I didn't serve my country just to have politicians chosen for me. I served to defend the principles of democracy and to ensure that every voice is heard. That's why I'm committed to working harder than ever to earn the trust and support of every voter in our district.” - Joseph Alfonso
Now is the time to push back against the cynics and the naysayers. Now is the time to fight for a government that truly represents the will of the people. Together, we can bring about the change we so desperately need.
But Joseph's commitment to making a difference doesn't end there. In 2022, our campaign brought the Boston Globe to West Michigan, highlighting the urgent need for change and the importance of grassroots movements. We understand that now, more than ever, we must fight harder than anyone else before us—and Joseph's campaign represents our best chance of securing victory in November.
Join us in this historic effort to reclaim our democracy and make Michigan's 4th Congressional District a beacon of progress and hope. Together, we can build a future that we can all be proud of.
In solidarity,
Alfonso For Congress Team

body:

| |
---
| | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2t7l8ehc3sh9hlqqni1dq9k47j0pk0d38pm20ug_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j6cpj0chh2bs)
---
| | Friend, **[**Will you help me strikeout the liberal lineup of Adam Schiff, Katie Porter, and Barbara Lee on March 5th?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgqt6j13lmmt0ig5f9ci9g6t7kbdav6dbcjde0i0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j6cpj0chh2bs)** That’s the day of the California primary. The top two go head-to-head in November.I can think of only one thing worse than a General Election ballot that forces Californians to “choose” between three dyed-in-the-wool leftists like Schiff, Porter, or Lee......and that’s being forced to endure six years of Schiff, Porter, or Lee in the U.S. Senate. I need your help to go “three up...three down” against this lineup of liberal career politicians.That’s a bit of baseball vernacular.No surprise, right?It means you record three outs against the first three batters in an inning.Then, it’s your team’s turn to go on offense. Well, that’s very much the case in this election... ...you and I need to strike out this lineup of liberals so we can get to work saving our country.Liberals straight out of Congress where all three have spent a combined 51 years – most recently acting as rubberstamps for the Biden agenda that has done so much harm to our state and our nation. Which is why I’m reaching out to you today.**[Will you step up and help strike out this “lineup of liberals” through a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdg0m9g5bv6sru3tggegslu9tb8hbgv98e6d6p4g_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j6cpj0chh2bs)** Think about the crumbling quality of life in my once-great state of California.Think about the daily reality of:
---
• Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California.• Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don’t lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction.
---
If you believe, as I do, that voters deserve better than a “false choice” between Schiff, Porter, and Lee on November 5, 2024, **[**then I need you to take immediate action and rush a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0hn9tup43j931ul71hln97ppgk786gnqp9dvjh0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j6cpj0chh2bs)** Winning this election requires a one-two punch:
---
1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign “connecting the dots” between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day.
---

body:
Will you help me strikeout the liberal lineup of Adam Schiff, Katie Porter, and Barbara Lee on March 5th?

| |
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrtm2v814l1apcrss1ccgqoqj06cfnfqr2m0k55g_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j62ob4s3h2bs)
---
| | Friend, **[**Will you help me strikeout the liberal lineup of Adam Schiff, Katie Porter, and Barbara Lee on March 5th?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf3edohi9pjttf2lua4avt67jcsiique2mcaug1o_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j62ob4s3h2bs)** That’s the day of the California primary. The top two go head-to-head in November.I can think of only one thing worse than a General Election ballot that forces Californians to “choose” between three dyed-in-the-wool leftists like Schiff, Porter, or Lee......and that’s being forced to endure six years of Schiff, Porter, or Lee in the U.S. Senate. I need your help to go “three up...three down” against this lineup of liberal career politicians.That’s a bit of baseball vernacular.No surprise, right?It means you record three outs against the first three batters in an inning.Then, it’s your team’s turn to go on offense. Well, that’s very much the case in this election... ...you and I need to strike out this lineup of liberals so we can get to work saving our country.Liberals straight out of Congress where all three have spent a combined 51 years – most recently acting as rubberstamps for the Biden agenda that has done so much harm to our state and our nation. Which is why I’m reaching out to you today.**[Will you step up and help strike out this “lineup of liberals” through a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl8baufabo6u4mmftmdui96krpllge2psbt25j18_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j62ob4s3h2bs)** Think about the crumbling quality of life in my once-great state of California.Think about the daily reality of:
---
• Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California.• Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don’t lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction.
---
If you believe, as I do, that voters deserve better than a “false choice” between Schiff, Porter, and Lee on November 5, 2024, **[**then I need you to take immediate action and rush a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhhbpg1m5s8iu37sdoer7usr5k3jf82drbcvuqro_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j62ob4s3h2bs)** Winning this election requires a one-two punch:
---
1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign “connecting the dots” between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day.
---
In my playing days, I would never be out-worked or out-hustled. That’s my approach to this campaign. Door-knocks, phone-calls, rallies, townhalls, you name it. **[But I need your help. I’d consider it a great honor to have you on my campaign team. I also consider your support a must have in order to win this race.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zchqtnm4d2qjdkje7ququb2ml0pp2tp1jqconvb0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30s1j62ob4s3h2bs)** With you on our side, I’m confident we can not only give voters a real choice, but someone who remembers how great California was and knows how great it can be again.
---
| | With deepest appreciation,
---
---
Steve GarveyRepublican for United States Senate

subject: THREE tries?!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Powered by People, [poweredxpeople
body:
This new citizen had to submit a voter registration application THREE times until Texas finally added her to the rolls.
#
Here's a real-life example of how hard it is to register to vote in Texas, and why Powered by People's work is so important.
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/62191?source=ema20240215-239465&t=1&akid=239465%2E444211%2EcnkoEp)
**_Texas Tribune_ reporter Natalia Contreras just wrote that it took THREE voter registration attempts and five months of delay for the Secretary of State to finally register her to vote:**
1. After becoming a naturalized citizen in May, Natalia immediately filled out a voter registration application. But months later, when she checked her status on the Secretary of State’s website, nothing showed up.
2. So she made her second attempt while renewing her driver’s license at her local Department of Public Safety office. But when she checked again weeks later, she still wasn’t registered to vote.
3. Less than a week before the voter registration deadline, she started to panic. That’s when she filled out a _third_ voter registration application and dropped it off in-person at the voter registrar’s office.

On her third try, it finally stuck. But as Natalia writes, “Not everyone has the ability, the time, or the resources to double-check their registration status and make multiple attempts. Being able to participate in democracy should not be this hard.”
We're often asked why Powered by People is spending so much time, energy, and resources on training Volunteer Deputy Registrars (VDRs) to help Texans register to vote. And Natalia’s story is the perfect example of why we do what we do.
Our VDRs act as “voter registration guides.” They help Texans navigate all of the bureaucracy and red tape and are putting in the work to make registering to vote as easy as possible. Because it _should_ be easy.
**Today, we could use your help to raise the funds we need to carry out this work.**

Thank you.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Yesterday’s tragedy in Kansas City
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends -
Today, we woke up in mourning—this time for Kansas City, Missouri.
Festivities came to a screeching halt yesterday at the end of the Chiefs Super Bowl parade when at least 20 people were shot outside Union Station, turning an afternoon of celebration into an afternoon of gunfire and panic. One person was killed.
Nine children who went to the parade to see their sports idols ended up being treated in the hospital for gunshot wounds, and countless other children will now be scarred by the trauma of surviving a mass shooting. This is devastating. No child should have to endure the pain of gun violence.
I am grieving right alongside you. But I am also more determined than ever. That’s because I know it doesn’t have to be this way. Our leaders can choose to act and pass commonsense gun safety legislation that can prevent shootings like these from happening. This is especially true for Missouri, which has some of the weakest gun laws in the country—and highest rates of gun violence.
I will not rest until we see a future free from gun violence in Missouri and in every state. Please, keep standing with me in the fight to end our nation’s gun violence crisis.
Sincerely,
Gabby Giffords

clean_body: Friends - Today, we woke up in mourning—this time for Kansas City, Missouri. Festivities came to a screeching halt yesterday at the end of the Chiefs Super Bowl parade when at least 20 people were shot outside Union Station, turning an afternoon of celebration into an afternoon of gunfire and panic. One person was killed. Nine children who went to the parade to see their sports idols ended up being treated in the hospital for gunshot wounds, and countless other children will now be scarred by the trauma of surviving a mass shooting. This is devastating. No child should have to endure the pain of gun violence. I am grieving right alongside you. But I am also more determined than ever. That’s because I know it doesn’t have to be this way. Our leaders can choose to act and pass commonsense gun safety legislation that can prevent shootings like these from happening. This is especially true for Missouri, which has some of the weakest gun laws in the country—and highest rates of gun violence. I will not rest until we see a future free from gun violence in Missouri and in every state. Please, keep standing with me in the fight to end our nation’s gun violence crisis. Sincerely, Gabby Giffords GIFFORDS PAC works to end gun violence by empowering voters with information and supporting candidates who will fight for safer gun laws. name: John Fetterman
subject: One year
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
# [](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/388?refcode=em20240215-8794-header&t=1&akid=8794%2E434096%2E9SJm4l)
Hi Derek,
Today is my son Karl's 15th birthday, and I'm so grateful to be able to spend it with him + the rest of the family today and this year.
2/15 also marks an anniversary: **It's been one year since I checked in to Walter Reed to receive treatment for my depression.** I'll never forget the decision. I had been in a dark place, and going to inpatient treatment on Karl's birthday left me feeling like a failure.
Clinical depression is no joke, and it convinces you that you're a loser, even if you've won. But slowly, over the course of a few weeks, I began to get better. My family was the single biggest motivation to take on my depression.
This isn't about 🔴 or 🔵 politics or party -- treatment works. It truly does. With medical help, therapy, and the support from my family, I found a way forward. Countless messages of support from this team meant the world to me, too.
Getting help changed my life, and I consider it a big duty of mine to pay it forward. I'm proud to be serving Pennsylvania in the Senate today — and excited to be with my family on Karl's birthday. 2/15 was one of the best days of my life, and one of the worst too. 15 years ago I was 9 hours or so into fatherhood. The 2009 version of me never could have imagined what 2024 would look like.
Today, I continue to honor the promise I made when I got better: **To share this message and to let people who may be in that place know there is a path to recovery.** It works. I promise you it does. Please promise yourself that you won't allow your very real struggles to a dangerous place of self-harm. Trust the process and keep yourself in the game no matter what.
And finally, from the bottom of my heart, I want to thank the professionals and soldiers at Walter Reed who helped me get better. Thanks to my family, too, who were there for me before, during and after my recovery. Lastly, thanks to my colleagues in the Senate, on both sides, who demonstrated empathy.
Thank you, thank you, thank you 🙏
❤️ John

_If you or someone you know is in crisis, reach out for help at one of the following resources:
Call 911: If someone is in immediate danger, call 911.
Call 988: Get connected to the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline by dialing 988._

| Peter,

**Last night, I joined Lawrence O’Donnell on MSNBC to discuss Donald Trump’s repeated promises to abandon our NATO allies and threaten America’s national security.**
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79081151/455378780/1993432125?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-02-15_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmNmNDlmMjItMmRjYy1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=3zIMk0QFsp5h935CsnrdS5lyTPVdAd-vD6qxhhPVvPw=)
In case you missed it, Trump has doubled down on his promise to imperil U.S. national security interests, abandon America’s NATO allies, and bow down to Vladimir Putin.

His actions are incredibly dangerous. They undermine not only our national security, but also the very fabric of our alliances and the very future of democracy around the world.

**As a Member of Congress and former CIA case officer, I have taken an oath multiple times to protect and defend the U.S. Constitution. We must do everything in our power to keep our word to our allies, keep our citizens safe, and maintain our role as a global leader.**

We know that former President Trump is ill-prepared and unfit to once again be the President of the United States. With the 2024 election around the corner, the threats to our institutions, our national security, and our democracy are growing. And tyrants, dictators, and terrorists alike are watching to see whether the United States will stand strong — or whether it will retreat on the world stage.

I've dedicated my life to serving our Commonwealth and our country — and I refuse to retreat. Whether as a current Member of Congress or as the future Governor of Virginia, I remain committed to our shared future.

[_**I will always put our safety, our democracy, and our institutions above politics. body:
Announcing the Pioneer PAC working to elect candidates to public office who support limited government, free enterprise, energy independence | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/01a949bd130d/announcing-the-pioneer-pac?e=c50edee7be)
---
Friend,
I am excited to announce the launch of the Pioneer PAC, a new political action committee working to elect candidates to public office who **support limited government, free enterprise, energy independence, safer neighborhoods, school choice and parental involvement in education.**
I wanted to personally reach out to you to let you know that I’m not done fighting for our country and the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.
You’ve always been there for me in the past.
[**Can I count on you to stand with me to help save Pennsylvania and America?**](https://thepioneerpac.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=13e7237d8e699912bccf59ab4&id=305b465e89&e=c50edee7be)
While taxpayers continue to face skyrocketing inflation, failing schools, rising energy costs, reckless spending and rampant crime across the country, Democrats continue to push one radical idea after another that weakens our state and country.
**These radicals despise normal everyday people like you and me. They think they know what is best for us.**
**BUT THEY ARE WRONG!**
Together, we must stop the Democrats woke agenda by supporting and promoting candidates who believe in Democracy, Freedom and the American Dream.
[**I hope I can count on you to chip in $25, $50 or $250!**](https://thepioneerpac.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=13e7237d8e699912bccf59ab4&id=ba7f882b08&e=c50edee7be)
**I’ve never backed down from a fight and I don’t intend to start now!**
| [DONATE](https://thepioneerpac.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=13e7237d8e699912bccf59ab4&id=c5bbd4784a&e=c50edee7be)

Sincerely,

subject: Chairwoman Karamo provides insights on moving forward.
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/migop.org/chairwoman-karamo-provides-insights-on-moving-forward?e=a2af77507c)
---
| |
---
| | Good Afternoon Fellow Republicans,

In light of the biased decision rendered by the RNC, I want to provide a list to outline what we are up against, where we are gaining ground, and what we must do to keep moving forward:

1\. The battle is simple. It’s the people who control the political machines (the uniparty monarchy) versus _We the People!_

2\. The “political lynch mob” fraudulently tried to use certain members of the State Committee to remove me and failed. The MIGOP Policy Committee and most of the State Committee voted against removing me.

3\. They tried to remove me in two different courts. Kalamazoo was a big defeat to Matt Deperno and his plan to derail me. The judge agreed that he was not entitled to relief from the 1/13 state committee recognizing Rod Halcomb as the chair of Kalamazoo. He was elected by delegates in a special convention in September of 2023.

In the other court, they were confident the judge would rule in their favor on February 2, but that also didn’t happen. The next step in that battle will take place on February 20-22.

4\. The RNC lawyers blindsided me with that ridiculous one-sided opinion after telling Jim, Dan, and myself that they could not get involved.

5\. On January 24, the RNC General Counsel put out a premature legal opinion that had no effect. Hence, RNC Chairwoman Ronna McDaniel put together a committee of people to cast doubt on my RNC seat. The problem is that they cannot address my State Committee seat because it is a separate political body, and no legal statute gives them the authority to do so. Their plan was a “political assassination” attempt--not a hearing, with the goal of removing me. We had under 72 hours to submit 1000 words and 20 minutes of argument. RNC counsel ran the show.

6\. Ronna is a lame duck, and the _We The People_ movement will hopefully change the make-up of that committee. We elect two members, and I am asking the delegates to resolve the issue (between Pete and me) regarding the third seat. I encourage you all to visit the MIGOP website and see the document written by the MIGOP General Counsel about the authority of the RNC.

7\. The chair of the select temporary subcommittee can only make recommendations to the entire national committee, which will meet next in July 2024.

8\. The RNC’s process resembles what the MIGOP State Policy sub-committee and State Committee did, but they reached an opposite conclusion. You decide if they have a vested interest.

9 I am still fighting for you.

10\. I encourage you to go to your county convention rooms today and make sure that the delegates who go to the March 2 MIGOP District Convention are prepared to select the right committee man and woman and resolve the fight I am in with Pete Hoekstra.

11\. Pete never supported my administration or raised money to help. Instead, he is part of the group subverting me. They want to make sure that, like the TEA party movement, our America First delegates never rise up again.

12\. This is a spiritual battle. Pray and ask for discernment and stay involved.

This is not the time to get discouraged. Although we love President Trump, he probably will reiterate his “endorsement” of Pete Hoekstra on Saturday. Ultimately, who serves as the Michigan Republican Party chair is not his decision; it's yours. We live in Michigan and know what's best for Michigan.

We must change the source of power and accountability from nameless funds and out-of-state power and return it to its rightful owners... We The People!

Remember, it is not negotiable for us to quit. In Liberty,

_Kristina Karamo_
Chairwoman
Michigan Republican Party

Peter — if the

Abortion Pill Case. Excerpt: Judge Matthew Kacsmaryk donated to Hawley's
campaign in 2018... Hawley is sworn in as senator in early 2019 and votes
to confirm Kacsmaryk in June 2019 (the vote was 52 to 46). A few months
after the Supreme Court overturned Roe, activists represented by ADF file
the abortion pill suit in Kacsmaryk's single-judge district. Hawley's wife
is part of the ADF team to argue the case before Kacsmaryk in March 2023.
Kacsmaryk then rules in favor of Hawley's wife. And, finally, Hawley signs
on to a Supreme Court amicus brief supporting his wife's case...

IN 2017: Matt Kacsmaryk was nominated to be a federal judge for the north
Texas district court.

His confirmation stalled for years. We learned he even lied to hide just
how bizarre his obsession with controlling people’s bodies really is:

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43762?refcode=em20240215-4824&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=4824%2E614464%2EbvfrH9 ]Headline from The Dallas Morning News: John Cornyn says Judge Kacsmaryk
should not have taken name off anti-abortion article. Excerpt: 'The
process only works if we... have candor and truthful answers. So that's
significant,' said Cornyn, a member of the Senate Judiciary Committee
responsible for vetting Kacsmaryk's nomination.

IN 2018: While his nomination languished in the Senate, Kacsmaryk made an
investment in his future.

So he became a campaign donor to Josh Hawley, a fellow member of the
Federalist Society — a group of corporate activist lawyers with funders
including Chevron, Google, and the Kochs.

IN 2019: Now a U.S. Senator, Josh Hawley decided to make Kacsmaryk, his
campaign donor, a federal judge.

Hawley confirmed Kacsmaryk to the northern Texas district court — despite
bipartisan opposition over Kacsmaryk’s Big Brother views on contraceptives
and personal freedoms.

IN 2022: A lawsuit was filed in the northern Texas district court by
activist lawyers seeking to ban an abortion pill that millions have used
safely. Abortion medication accounts for over half of all abortions.

Josh Hawley’s wife led the suit. His donor was the judge.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43762?refcode=em20240215-4824&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=4824%2E614464%2EbvfrH9 ]Photos of Josh Hawley and Texas Judge Matthew Kacsmaryk on the left. On
the right, a Vanity Fair headline that reads: Erin Morrow Hawley is
leading the charge to ban abortion medication. She's also Josh Hawley's
wife.

APRIL 2023: Hawley’s donor judge ruled in favor of the suit led by
Hawley’s wife, calling for a near-immediate ban on the abortion pill
mifepristone in all 50 states.

This was the first time a judge has ever unilaterally tried to take a drug
off the market against FDA objections.

Then, in his official capacity as U.S. Senator, Josh Hawley submitted an
amicus brief demanding that the Supreme Court end a temporary injunction
blocking the ruling (in his wife's lawsuit) by a judge (his campaign
donor) to ban America's most commonly-used abortion medication.

AND NOW: We’ve learned that the mifepristone case (led by Hawley’s wife)
is being reviewed by the Supreme Court.

But this is hardly the first time that the Hawley family business has made
it all the way to the Supreme Court:

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43762?refcode=em20240215-4824&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=4824%2E614464%2EbvfrH9 ]Tweet from Josh Hawley on June 24, 2022: For those who wondered why I
said, two years ago, I would vote to confirm ONLY Supreme Court Justices
who acknowledged Roe was wrong, this is why. Amy Barrett was the first
openly pro-life nominee of my lifetime. And she was the deciding vote.

Josh Hawley has led the charge to ban abortion in our country — and this
year, we’re going to make Hawley own it. [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43762?refcode=em20240215-4824&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=4824%2E614464%2EbvfrH9 ]So if you’re ready to end
these Big Brother attacks on abortion and send a real warrior for working
people to represent Missouri in the U.S. Senate, please rush a donation of

Hawley's wife is part of the ADF team to argue the case before Kacsmaryk in March 2023. Kacsmaryk then rules in favor of Hawley's wife. And, finally, Hawley signs on to a Supreme Court amicus brief supporting his wife's case... IN 2017: Matt Kacsmaryk was nominated to be a federal judge for the north Texas district court. His confirmation stalled for years. We learned he even lied to hide just how bizarre his obsession with controlling people’s bodies really is: [ ]Headline from The Dallas Morning News: John Cornyn says Judge Kacsmaryk should not have taken name off anti-abortion article. Excerpt: 'The process only works if we... have candor and truthful answers. So that's significant,' said Cornyn, a member of the Senate Judiciary Committee responsible for vetting Kacsmaryk's nomination. IN 2018: While his nomination languished in the Senate, Kacsmaryk made an investment in his future. So he became a campaign donor to Josh Hawley, a fellow member of the Federalist Society — a group of corporate activist lawyers with funders including Chevron, Google, and the Kochs. IN 2019: Now a U.S. Senator, Josh Hawley decided to make Kacsmaryk, his campaign donor, a federal judge. Hawley confirmed Kacsmaryk to the northern Texas district court — despite bipartisan opposition over Kacsmaryk’s Big Brother views on contraceptives and personal freedoms. IN 2022: A lawsuit was filed in the northern Texas district court by activist lawyers seeking to ban an abortion pill that millions have used safely. Abortion medication accounts for over half of all abortions. Josh Hawley’s wife led the suit. His donor was the judge. [ ]Photos of Josh Hawley and Texas Judge Matthew Kacsmaryk on the left. On the right, a Vanity Fair headline that reads: Erin Morrow Hawley is leading the charge to ban abortion medication. She's also Josh Hawley's wife. APRIL 2023: Hawley’s donor judge ruled in favor of the suit led by Hawley’s wife, calling for a near-immediate ban on the abortion pill mifepristone in all 50 states. This was the first time a judge has ever unilaterally tried to take a drug off the market against FDA objections. Then, in his official capacity as U.S. Senator, Josh Hawley submitted an amicus brief demanding that the Supreme Court end a temporary injunction blocking the ruling (in his wife's lawsuit) by a judge (his campaign donor) to ban America's most commonly-used abortion medication. AND NOW: We’ve learned that the mifepristone case (led by Hawley’s wife) is being reviewed by the Supreme Court. Amy Barrett was the first openly pro-life nominee of my lifetime. And she was the deciding vote. Josh Hawley has led the charge to ban abortion in our country — and this year, we’re going to make Hawley own it. About the recent inflation report
The current inflation rate (CPI) is 3.1%. But, prices for everyday goods are not falling. This is why.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Your contributions help Dr. Bob advocate for neighbors in our communities who are struggling. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately.

CONTRIBUTE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=express_lane_25]
CONTRIBUTE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=50&refcode=express_lane_50]
Friend,
We must do something to rein in corporations' hold on the economy. A new inflation report was released this week, and here are some of my observations.
Housing
Housing price increases account for more than two-thirds of the inflation rate. It has a significant impact on the economy. Excluding the housing increases, the inflation rate would be near 1%. We can do so much to ease the cost of housing. It just takes political will.
More alarming is the "core CPI," which excludes food and energy. It's at 3.9%, highlighting a frustrating component of price increases: "greedflation" and "shrinkflation".
Grocery prices
Food prices are still increasing despite declining wholesale prices. With record profits, food companies should be passing on the lower costs to their consumers. They're not.
Greedflation or "shrinkflation", getting less for your buck, is well on display on grocery store shelves; e.g. smaller rolls of toilet paper for the same old price.
Some companies are proving corporations can prioritize their costumers, not just shareholders. For example, the founder of Arizona Ice Tea committed to keeping its staple beverage at just 99¢.
It's possible.
Automobile prices
Automobile prices, both new and used, are reaching unprecedented heights. How a working-class family is expected to afford $30,000-50,000 or more for a family car is mind-boggling.
Friend, inflation rate has improved, but corporations still control prices, and it's high time we elect leaders who will stand up and fight for hard working families to shape a more sustainable economy for everyday Americans.
I'm eager to lead that fight for my district and beyond, and your grassroots support makes it possible.
Thank you.
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

clean_body: Friend, We have exciting news! The general election for U.S. Senate in New Mexico starts today! The Secretary of State just announced we have cleared the field and It 's time to get to work! Our campaign is about the priorities of all New Mexico voters, and I look forward to meeting, listening to, and earning the vote of New Mexicans across the state. Every day, more and more families are joining our hard-working team because they know I value collaboration, which will address the dysfunction, partisanship, and gridlock in Washington. The enthusiastic momentum is apparent as our campaign - thanks to thousands of supporters - submitted more ballot petition signatures than Martin Heinrich and every other candidate who filed for the ballot in New Mexico. I'm excited to be a force for New Mexico families in Washington, serving our community, driving solutions, and meeting the needs of our state. I know we're better together. New Mexico has extraordinary assets, ranging from our rich heritage and culture, to our abundant natural resources, to our exceptional national labs and military bases. We must unify our state and nation. I care deeply about our nation's future and I know we can win in New Mexico! Thank you, Republican for Senate | Paid for by the NRSC. | | | Hi there, it's Chuck. I want to take a moment to talk about the power of taking one seemingly small act: **[Chipping in $5 to help us defend the Senate today.](https://go.dscc.org/go/17373?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20240215-ChuckSchumer-SchumerSmallActFR-ETG-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20240215-ChuckSchumer-SchumerSmallActFR-ETG-sl1&akid=13534%2E9716520%2EnfB3Jr)**

They don't do it because they somehow _know_ their $5 or $10 will win or lose the election. And while it's true that when we all act as one, we become stronger than a deep-pocketed megadonor's checkbook, that's not the reason either.

**They do it because they want to make _sure_ that when the history of this moment is written -- when our rights were on the line and MAGA authoritarianism was coming for our democracy -- they'll be _on the record_ fighting for our country's values.**

So I'm coming to you with a simple request: Will you seize the power in your hands and take a seemingly small action TODAY to make an impact on the outcome of this year's election? Our Triple-Impact Match is active, so there's no better time than _right now_ to make a difference.

The group _says_ they do not take corporate money, but in reality, they have received hundreds of thousands of dollars from major corporations and business lobbying groups. No Labels claims to be for the middle-ground, but has connections with major right-wing donors like David Koch and Harlan Crow. They even plan to run a candidate for President this year if Joe Biden and Donald Trump are the nominees.**[**No Labels is nothing but a scam so executives can keep lining their pockets at the expense of American families. The American people deserve so much better than being purposefully misled by scam organizations like these. **** By now you know Mad loves getting out and meeting with her neighbors and fellow community members. On top of just enjoying the conversations, she wants to hear about the issues that matter most to hard-working Pennsylvanians – and what they want to see from Congress.

_**Meeting the voters where they are is crucial to any campaign, but it’s especially meaningful to Mad as a lifelong resident of PA-04. We’re excited to ramp up our organizing efforts – here’s a typical “day in the life” for campaign organizers:**_
|
* Log on to the voter database, pull a list of voters, and “cut turf”

* Drive to the given neighborhood to canvass

* Spend hours talking to voters and building relationships

* Eat lunch!

* Meet with volunteers

* Spend the rest of the day spreading the word about our campaign

---

_Being an organizer is a hard job – just ask one_. But everyone agrees that this work is some of the most important in the whole campaign. The opportunity to meet voters where they are can make or break any election effort.

As we’re building out our field team, we’re raising money to make sure that our organizers get everything they need to do the hard work. That’s where you come in. We need:

* $8,000 to bring on two field staff members.
* $3,500 to continue paying for our voter database.
* $1,500 for miscellaneous needs (like gas, office supplies, paper, and other volunteer needs)

---

Now, as senator, she's on the frontlines of the fights that matter most to families. But as the 2024 election heats up, GOP megadonors are targeting Kirsten's seat for defeat. And right now, she's falling short of her critical $50,000 mid-month goal. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Trust me on this: Kirsten delivers results._ Over the last couple of years, she's won legislation to reform our military's criminal justice system, protect survivors of sexual harassment and assault, expand benefits for veterans and 9/11 first responders, crack down on gun trafficking, and tackle corruption in Washington. Now, she's leading the charge to win guaranteed paid family leave, certify the Equal Rights Amendment, restore reproductive rights, protect seniors, and so much more. I've had the privilege of working closely with Kirsten on these issues and so many others. I've seen her fight harder than just about anyone else to build coalitions across the aisle, block dangerous bills, and get her legislation across the finish line. And I'm not exaggerating here: While in the House, Kirsten gave birth to her second son mere hours after working a 13-hour day. Kirsten is one of a kind. And families in New York and across the nation need her voice in Washington advocating for their rights, priorities, and futures. But that's why the GOP is ready to do everything within their power to defeat her this fall. New York Republicans celebrated their best election cycle in decades in 2022. Their extremist candidates flipped enough seats in the midterms to win control of the House and came within single digits of winning the governorship. Now, they're directly targeting Kirsten's seat to retake Senate control. I know that my friend has what it takes to defeat the GOP and their megadonors. But because she refuses to accept money from corporate PACs, she's counting on strong grassroots support to win this critical race.= | | = Thank you for taking the time to support my friend and help defend our Senate majority. With gratitude, Chuck Schumer | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

In this episode of Navigating Uncertainty, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Tobias Peter, Co-Director of the American Enterprise Institute's Housing Center. Toby shares the story of growing up in Germany, participating in a exchange student program in Minnesota, and eventually heading to Washington DC after graduating from the Harvard Kennedy School. He describes the work being done at the American Enterprise Institute and the Housing Center that he helps run. In addition to providing clear thinking about how to address America's increasingly urgent housing crisis, Toby shares wonderful advice on how to navigate uncertainty: Keep an open mind, stay determined, and don't be afraid to ask for help!

name: Sam Brown
subject: They blew up my body, but they’ll never destroy my spirit.
body:
You can never take away the heart of a soldier

| |
---
| | | Friend,

**[This was God's message for me.](https://links.greatamericatoday.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5f10b337da894cbdaf6880b85068d3d4&_e=ve_fAW90OQLwW9zL6vRdwrH9BA1HrbHDGslcMXhigHRR6pvoCotP-Lgah_Jp3VT06JWNDX9RsTsrDh-VxxK7D1wOqrERoP9uUI3FQ4gBieHC0UKDxoSrHhq_FzrGZTlktXdZm8tD2MrDwLH-OT44wwT7fDvTEbqqVONukgpN1rbO8NPREV9SeRKP9yGu6DagNLIXl81xigK8QTGibWu6xUgZr99J2diXAA_xgHBGHYVG6XRnmkx_s7ZsbRtTkRcatMlNc7FHANiWj_E1ktKJEBuzQyqQvS9ez00M7B3C_iwV4_LfXkpIZI46QQ_jFo1_dOIZzP18LroMaUJPas6Jqg%3D%3D "This was God’s message for me. ")**

I didn't know if I was going to survive -- but I knew if I did, my life would belong to Him forever.

In 2008, a roadside bomb in Afghanistan left me with burns over half my body. This was my vehicle after the explosion.

---
| [](https://links.greatamericatoday.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5f10b337da894cbdaf6880b85068d3d4&_e=ve_fAW90OQLwW9zL6vRdwrH9BA1HrbHDGslcMXhigHRR6pvoCotP-Lgah_Jp3VT06JWNDX9RsTsrDh-VxxK7D1wOqrERoP9uUI3FQ4gBieHC0UKDxoSrHhq_FzrGZTlktXdZm8tD2MrDwLH-OT44wwT7fDvTEbqqVONukgpN1rbO8NPREV9SeRKP9yGu6DagoiGE-40PGcgNy--_XmY7zmNjLukX4Bs0T9iJ68YEtrmPr1IRnBbLSbvqVA0MBBqfnESS7RXtprVPdUlw0w7wHfE593V4gFNTLSgOycgbyefw9O2qLntPGIMDHOa-YyhXwucbpVL7qM5Wg2K6EMy-Hw%3D%3D)
---

My path to recovery wasn't easy -- I spent months wondering if my life could ever be the same, asking myself why God spared me that day.

**But that was God 's way of speaking to me, THIS was His message to me...His plan for me.**

Friend, I realized that my life would NEVER be the same, but that was okay. I was alive for one reason:

_**My new life belonged not to me, but to Him.

That's why I've lived every day since with three things in mind: My country, my family, and God Himself. **_

God used the tragedy that resulted in my injuries to tell me something.

Through 3 years of recovery and over 30 surgeries- I was never alone. Not for one second.

God stayed with me through it all and he made it clear to me that I was NOT called to wish for my old life.

**Instead, I was called to live my new life to the fullest in service to Him.**

That's why I spent the last 15 years starting my family, serving fellow veterans through the business I started, and most recently, **[I launched my campaign to become the next U.S. Senator from Nevada.](https://links.greatamericatoday.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5f10b337da894cbdaf6880b85068d3d4&_e=ve_fAW90OQLwW9zL6vRdwrH9BA1HrbHDGslcMXhigHRR6pvoCotP-Lgah_Jp3VT06JWNDX9RsTsrDh-VxxK7D1wOqrERoP9uUI3FQ4gBieHC0UKDxoSrHhq_FzrGZTlktXdZm8tD2MrDwLH-OT44wwT7fDvTEbqqVONukgpN1rbO8NPREV9SeRKP9yGu6Dagj1V_9F6GmwaKqFnEj62dQC6iCVX_yMiQTLKtuT3uUdfVR7qdYw_M0NigtHG-fccOSlStGhhznm524ByAhHav75uks4uSijnUGZq4z0ZSI0l9OlDIer3KHfVbzGh25IsGzQnmiQLWAl0gr6UaSSyhgg%3D%3D "I launched my campaign to become the next U.S. Senator from Nevada.")**

America is at a tipping point.

Corrupt leaders are leading us into total madness.

Our border is collapsing.

Parents are being cut-off from their children in schools.

We're spending away our future and the future of our children's children.

I'm running for U.S. Senate to bring a new generation of Conservative leadership to Washington D.C.

But to do that, Friend, I'll need your help.

So I'm hoping that you can help me with 1 or 2 things.
1. Would you please keep me and my family in your prayers as we take on some of the most powerful elites in the world?
2. **[Would you consider sending in $5 or $10 to help fund my campaign?](https://links.greatamericatoday.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5f10b337da894cbdaf6880b85068d3d4&_e=ve_fAW90OQLwW9zL6vRdwrH9BA1HrbHDGslcMXhigHRR6pvoCotP-Lgah_Jp3VT06JWNDX9RsTsrDh-VxxK7D1wOqrERoP9uUI3FQ4gBieHC0UKDxoSrHhq_FzrGZTlktXdZm8tD2MrDwLH-OT44wwT7fDvTEbqqVONukgpN1rbO8NPREV9SeRKP9yGu6Dag2rIjXM4cMZULSXPkZSvI9LQEQYjvRelt8KereT2UJpUXOODuM74Cxe_AH3NhoROsf3ScJLqaPqCEFp4NysR7SAbnpGNL8ObP8PDoavXqqOZVEHaoMFGdNzwJaUc4AjkROqk4MMS6HsV8L-I3lzpEYw%3D%3D "Would you consider sending in $5 or $10 to help fund my campaign?")** I don't come from money and I'm no millionaire- that means that support from people like you will have a real impact on this election.

Asking for help isn't something that comes easy for me. I'm a combat veteran and a man of faith. But God has humbled me enough to know that I can't do this with HIM and without people like YOU.

Duty First,
---

---

Sam Brown

body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/successsequence-11571682?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,
MCPP teamed up with the Heritage Foundation to host a packed lunch about China. Senator Roger Wicker and leading foreign policy strategist, Michael Pillsbury, spoke to 130 guests. You can watch what they said here:
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=32c34eb887&e=5703353baa)
---
Click on the link above to watch
| Drawing from his bestselling book about China, “The Hundred Year Marathon”, Michael Pillsbury explained just how easy it is for China to gain access to top-secret American defense plans.
---
|
---
| Pillsbury explained how under President Nixon and Henry Kissinger, America initially took a pro-China approach, seeking to engage and assist what was then the world’s most populous country. China, Pillsbury suggested, has learned our strategy all too well and is able to take advantage of it.
---
|
---
| Senator Wicker then emphasized the great need for America to strengthen our military presence.
---
|
---
| Wicker went on to emphasize the importance of the US navy and the need to ensure the navy had sufficient strength and capabilities.
---
|
---

Hi friends —
**[It’s Robert. I am writing to humbly ask you to contribute to my reelection campaign today before we reach our mid-month deadline at midnight tonight.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79093493/455410200/764803318?refcode2=3206ef97-3fcc-ee11-85f9-002248223794&refcode=em240215-1-t2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjA2ZWY5Ny0zZmNjLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jMZ3KZXo51JXHQIKmJM_qsiH6HX83mCcwmC5Xu-_XTY=)**
We are in this fight for much more than my House seat. This November, we are in the fight to protect our democracy from MAGA extremists.
Over the past year, we have seen the detrimental consequences of having a Republican House majority controlled by its far-right MAGA wing.
We’ve seen impeachment shams against President Biden and Secretary Mayorkas — all being led by Trump’s MAGA puppets in the House.
We’ve seen Republicans fall back on deals and risk government shutdowns time and time again — no matter how detrimental it may be to the American economy and working families.
And we’ve even seen MAGA extremists remove their own leader and Speaker and instill a vocally homophobic Speaker in his place.
This is what the People’s House has looked like since the Republican party has taken control.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/26fCjk7Qedvc0KVxectMzw~~/AARclAA~~)

Friend,

We have exciting news! The general election for U.S. Senate in New Mexico starts today! The Secretary of State just announced we have cleared the field and **[I will be the Republican nominee for the New Mexico U.S. Senate.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/26fCjk7Qedvc0KVxectMzw~~/AARclAA~~)**

_It 's time to get to work!_

Our campaign is about the priorities of all New Mexico voters, and I look forward to meeting, listening to, and earning the vote of New Mexicans across the state. Every day, more and more families are joining our hard-working team because they know I value collaboration, which will address the dysfunction, partisanship, and gridlock in Washington.

The enthusiastic momentum is apparent as our campaign - thanks to thousands of supporters - submitted more ballot petition signatures than Martin Heinrich and every other candidate who filed for the ballot in New Mexico. **[We had support from all of New Mexico's 33 counties.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/26fCjk7Qedvc0KVxectMzw~~/AARclAA~~)**

I'm excited to be a force for New Mexico families in Washington, serving our community, driving solutions, and meeting the needs of our state.

I know we're better together.

New Mexico has extraordinary assets, ranging from our rich heritage and culture, to our abundant natural resources, to our exceptional national labs and military bases.

We must unify our state and nation.

I care deeply about our nation's future and I know we can win in New Mexico!

**[I'm all in, and I hope you will join the team.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/26fCjk7Qedvc0KVxectMzw~~/AARclAA~~)**

Thank you,

[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/26fCjk7Qedvc0KVxectMzw~~/AARclAA~~)
**[Nella Domenici](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/26fCjk7Qedvc0KVxectMzw~~/AARclAA~~)**

Derek, on
Monday night, I made my case on the debate stage for why I have the track
record and experience to take on the tough fights that California’s next
U.S. Senator needs to win.

That was in stark contrast to the leading Republican, Steve Garvey.

He lamented California’s homelessness crisis but said the federal minimum
wage of $7.25 per hour is fine right where it is.

He refused to say whether he would vote for Donald Trump a third time or
accept his endorsement but called my advocacy to reform the Supreme Court
and abolish the filibuster “the single greatest threat to Democracy.”

No, Mr. Garvey. The single greatest threat to our democracy is the
twice-impeached, four-times-indicted former President who incited an
insurrection to stop the peaceful transfer of power.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em.yNAKTE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20240215_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1004&akid=5506%2E5257348%2ETvvi8e ]We have just 19 days to make our case to California. Every registered
voter receives their ballot in the mail, and thousands are voting every
day. Can you rush a donation of

amount to our campaign?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your

Garvey’s attempts to smear me are pretty rich.

As Chair of the House Intelligence Committee, I investigated and impeached
Donald Trump for his abuse of office. I served as lead manager of his
Senate trial and served on the January 6 Committee after the insurrection
he incited.

Speaker Pelosi trusted me with these responsibilities because she needed
someone who would deliver results. That’s what I did — our impeachment
prosecution produced the first bipartisan vote to convict a sitting
president, and the January 6 Committee laid out much of the evidence that
has proven central to Special Counsel Jack Smith’s indictment of Trump.

Not to mention the legislation and funding I’ve delivered to make life
better for Californians. I’ve delivered for our state before, and I will
continue to do so as a U.S. Senator.

You can’t walk down the halls of Congress without tripping over five
people who say they’re going to shake up Washington, but they don’t end up
getting anything actually accomplished. I’ve delivered.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em.yNAKTE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20240215_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1011&akid=5506%2E5257348%2ETvvi8e ]I made the case to California why we need to do so much more — and how
I plan to lead those fights as your next Senator. We have less than 3
weeks until my primary election.
Derek,
chip in
$10 for
this homestretch.

Thanks for all of your support during this critical time for our campaign.
I cannot thank you enough.

— Adam

# ACTION, ACTION, ACTION

Friends, Monday we will begin to hear House bills debated on the Senate floor. As you may have noticed, there have been no House bills to debate since Wednesday. It's not because there is no work to be done, but because all House bills must first be heard in subcommittees and committees.
It takes several days for House bills to be heard and voted on in committee and then there are 3 Constitutional reads of each bill that comes before the full Senate.
In the Senate, debate takes place on the 3rd Constitutional read of each bill. This is different than when bills are debated in the House.
I would also like to point out that any House bills that are identical to Senate bills that have already been heard once, are not reheard again in the Senate. The work after crossover takes place more quickly after crossover, which makes way for dealing with the budget.
YOU can participate remotely with your legislators from the comfort of your home.
YOU can watch Senate Committees in action and at the right time, comment to the committee in real time.
This is YOUR opportunity to DO SOMETHING.
Above I have listed the dockets for THIS FRIDAY'S Senate Committee hearings. By clicking each link you can quickly look over which bills are coming up this Friday that are of interest to you.
Find a bill that interests you and want to comment remotely?
Then click on the link below to the streaming of the committee meeting and follow the directions to either view the committee in real time or comment remotely to the Senate committee members in real time to state your support or opposition to a particular bill.
It's that easy to express your support or opposition to a bill coming up on this Friday's docket.

body:
The hottest gift this Valentines Day is a contribution to their favorite candidate -- and other news.

View this email in your browser (https://us17.campaign-archive.com/?e=3d27610f3d&u=377cebd307a6b880bd19996d8&id=17630f245d)

** Hey Peter. Will you be my Valentine?
------------------------------------------------------------
Today is Valentine's Day, a day set aside to reflect on and appreciate those things that we hold dear to our hearts; the people, places, and memories that we love. I hope that you are able to spend today with people you cherish.

Remember, the best way to say I love you is to make a donation to your favorite candidate.

Click below give the most appreciated -- and tax deductible -- gift of love this Valentine's Day!
Click to Contribute (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/christianforga6?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=17630f245d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_13_03_35_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-9528662311-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Joking aside, today also marks the beginning of Lent, a 40 day season dedicated to self-reflection and improvement that is usually celebrated by giving up something, whether hobby or habit, that you love for those 40 days.

It is an interesting combination, and it has given me pause as I think about the things I love and what among those things I would be willing to let go. At the end of the day, I think my answers are the same as yours. At least, I hope so.

I love my wife. Without her there would be no me.

I love my daughters. Without them I would not worry about our future.

I love my country. Without it I would not have the opportunity to reach my full potential or the chance to help others reach theirs.

Obviously, there are so many more things on the list: puppies, kittens, flowers, birds, the color of the sky after it rains, or the sight of the sun dipping into the ocean. Love is easy.

The hard part is giving something up. What on that list can I do away with for a meager 40 days, much less a lifetime?

Oddly enough, I am giving up something that is not on the list of love, but is still a part of me -- I am giving up on hatred.

I hate the fact that I consider my neighbors and friends enemies because they disagree with me. I hate the fact that our country has become so hyper-partisan that a football game becomes a political statement. The list of things I hate goes on for at least as long as the things I love, but it starts with I hate the idea that we, as Americans, can't talk to each other.

So, I'm not going to believe it anymore, and I challenge you to do the same. At least for the next 40 days.

Our work fighting climate change is like climbing a mountain. It’s going to take time and a lot of hard work to reach the top, but there are also important points along the way. We have to continue making progress every year, step by step, to get to a just and equitable climate future. This session, that means passing **Right to Repair** , which will give Oregonians the ability to repair their electronic devices so they can use them longer and keep them out of the landfill, reducing e-waste and cutting pollution associated with manufacturing new devices. It also means passing a strong **Climate Budget** to continue funding the important climate programs we’ve passed over the last few years, including the Healthy Homes Program and the Charge Ahead Electric Vehicle Rebate program. We need your help to ensure that we pass these important priorities this session, and to ensure that we have the resources we need to continue climbing the mountain to a just and equitable climate future. Hogan said he “understands” abortion rights are "an emotional issue for women" in Maryland.
He even claimed that _“there’s no threat”_ to abortion rights in Maryland.
Abortion rights aren't just an "emotional issue for women." Women don’t need _help_ managing our emotions or our bodies. It’s about health care, about our basic freedoms, privacy, and control over our own bodies.
And, unfortunately, there IS a clear and present threat to abortion rights in Maryland. His name is _Larry Hogan_.
Just look at Hogan’s own record on reproductive healthcare:
* Vetoed a bill to relax restrictions on reproductive healthcare providers in Maryland
* Vetoed funding to train healthcare providers to perform abortions safely
* Vetoed a bill requiring health insurance companies to cover abortions with no costs to patients
* Vetoed a bill to guarantee 12 weeks of paid family leave for new parents

And we can’t forget that Mitch McConnell – who’s spent decades undermining abortion rights – handpicked Larry Hogan to run in Maryland’s Senate race, going so far as to call him his "best recruit of the cycle."
**[Peter, there are already FAR too many anti-choice Senators on Capitol Hill. We need pro-choice champions in the Senate willing to go to the mat for abortion access. That’s why we’re asking if you’ll help us elect Angela Alsobrooks as Maryland’s next U.S. Senator.
